title: BBC seeks to subpoena Trump's family members in Panorama lawsuit
english: The BBC is attempting to legally compel Donald Trump’s family members, including Ivanka Trump, Donald Trump Jr., and Jared Kushner, to provide evidence for a $10 billion defamation case brought by the former president. The lawsuit concerns a BBC documentary segment that allegedly mischaracterized a speech Trump gave before the 2021 Capitol riots. Legal representatives for the BBC argue that these family members possess vital information regarding the speech and have asked the court to allow the subpoenas to be delivered via mail after personal delivery attempts were blocked.
amharic: ቢቢሲ የቀድሞው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በድርጅቱ ላይ የመሰረቱትን የ10 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የውርደት ክስ ለመከላከል፣ የቤተሰባቸው አባላትን ማለትም ኢቫንካ ትራምፕን፣ ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጁኒየርን እና ጃሬድ ኩሽነርን በምስክርነት እና በማስረጃነት ማቅረብ ይፈልጋል። ክሱ ያተኮረው እ.ኤ.አ በ2021 በተከሰተው የካፒቶል ሁከት ወቅት ትራምፕ ያደረጉትን ንግግር ቢቢሲ በፕሮግራሙ ላይ አዛብቶ አቅርቧል በሚል ነው። የቢቢሲ ጠበቆች እነዚህ የቤተሰብ አባላት ስለ ንግግሩ ዝርዝር መረጃ ስላላቸው ምስክርነታቸው አስፈላጊ ነው በማለት፣ በአካል ለማድረስ የተሞከሩት ጥሪዎች ስላልተሳኩ በፖስታ እንዲላኩ ለፍርድ ቤት አቤቱታ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: BBCn himata arrirsoo bililiyoona 10 kan pirezidaantii duraanii Doonald Tiraamp irratti dhiyeessan ittisuuf, miseensota maatii isaanii kanneen akka Ivaanka Tiraamp, Doonald Tiraamp Jr. fi Jaared Kushnar ragaa akka kennan dirqisiisuuf yaalaa jira. Himatichi sagantaa BBC 'Panorama' irratti haasawa Tiraamp guyyaa jeequmsa Kaapitol dura taasisan jijjiiramee dhiyaate jechuun kan ka'e dha. Abukaattoonni BBC akka jedhanitti, miseensonni maatii kun haasawicha irratti hubannoo gahaa qabu, kanaafis yaalii fuul-duraatti wal-qunnamsiisuun hin milkoofneef, seeraan ragaa kana erguuf hayyama mana murtii gaafatanii jiru.

title: Iran says no decision yet on a return to talks with the US
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi stated that Iran has not decided to resume formal negotiations with the United States regarding the ongoing conflict. While Iran is coordinating with Oman to establish new temporary shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz, the minister emphasized that reopening the waterway depends on the U.S. meeting specific conditions. Tensions remain high as both nations exchange warnings over the strategic importance and control of the strait.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ አገራቸው ከአሜሪካ ጋር የነበረውን ድርድር እንደገና ለመጀመር ገና ውሳኔ ላይ እንዳልደረሱ አስታውቀዋል። ኢራን በሆርሙዝ የባህር በር አዳዲስ የመርከብ መስመሮችን ለመዘርጋት ከኦማን ጋር እየሰራች ቢሆንም፣ የባህር መንገዱ አገልግሎት እንዲጀምር አሜሪካ የቀረቡላትን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች ማሟላት እንዳለባት ሚኒስትሩ አሳስበዋል። በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ስላለው የባህር በር ቁጥጥር እና ስልታዊ ፋይዳው ያለው ውጥረት አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbaas Araagchi akka jedhanitti, biyyi isaanii marii Ameerikaa waliin deebi'anii jalqabuuf murtoo irra hin geenye. Iraan karaa haaraa dooniiwwan ittiin darban kan Hormuz keessatti uumuuf Omaan waliin hojjachaa jirtus, karaa kana banuun haal-dureewwan Ameerikaan guutuu qabdu irratti kan hundaa'e ta'uu ibsaniiru. Mootummoonni lamaan to'annoo fi iddoo barbaachisaa kan ta'e naannoo Hormuz irratti wal-hubachiisaa waan jiraniif, waldhabdeen kun itti fufee jira.

title: What we know about the crisis aboard the USS Lincoln
english: Reports have emerged regarding severe living conditions and a mental health crisis affecting the crew of the USS Abraham Lincoln amid ongoing regional tensions. While these concerns about the ship's internal state have gained attention, the US President has officially dismissed the claims. The situation highlights the scrutiny placed on US military assets during active operations against Iran.
amharic: በኢራን ላይ በሚካሄደው ውጥረት መካከል የUSS አብርሃም ሊንከን የጦር መርከብ ሠራተኞች የከፋ የኑሮ ሁኔታ እና የአእምሮ ጤና ችግር እየገጠማቸው እንደሆነ መረጃዎች ወጥተዋል። እነዚህን ዘገባዎች ተከትሎ ስጋቶች ቢነሱም፣ የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ግን ጉዳዩን ውድቅ አድርገውታል። ይህ ክስተት በኢራን ላይ በሚደረጉ ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴዎች ወቅት የአሜሪካ የጦር መርከቦች ላይ ያለውን ጫና አመላካች ነው።
oromo: Waraana Iraan waliin walqabatee, markaba waraanaa USS Abraham Lincoln irra jiran irratti haalli jireenyaa fi fayyaan sammuu hammaataa jiraachuu gabaasni ni mul'isa. Gabaasoota kanneen irratti dhiphinnii fi komiin ka'us, pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa himannaa kana dhugoomsanii hin fudhanne. Haalli kun hojii waraana Ameerikaa kan biyyattii Iraan irratti gaggeeffamu keessatti qormaata isaan mudachuu danda'u kan agarsiisu dha.

title: Did the US really destroy Iran’s ballistic missile capability?
english: There is significant skepticism surrounding the United States' assertion that Iran's ballistic missile power has been dismantled. Experts suggest that the U.S. government's claim is unrealistic and likely exaggerated. To effectively confront Iran, officials indicate that the U.S. would face a difficult decision between committing a massive military force or risking failure.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መንግስት የኢራን የባለስቲክ ሚሳኤል አቅም አፈራርሻለሁ የሚለው መግለጫ በብዙዎች ዘንድ ጥርጣሬን ፈጥሯል። ባለሙያዎች እንደሚናገሩት ይህ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ የይገባኛል ጥያቄ ተጨባጭነት የሌለው እና የተጋነነ ሊሆን እንደሚችል ነው። ኢራንን በወታደራዊ መንገድ ለመግታት አሜሪካ እጅግ ብዙ ቁጥር ያለው ወታደር ከማሰማራት ወይም በኢራን ፊት ከመሸነፍ አንዱን መምረጥ የሚል አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ ውስጥ እንደምትገኝ ይነገራል።
oromo: Mootummaan Ameerikaa dandeettii meeshaa waraanaa 'ballistic missile' kan Iraan barbadeesseera jechuun isaa shakkii guddaa uumeera. Ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, ibsi kun kan dhugaa irraa fagaate fi kan qabamee irra dabalamu dha. Ameerikaan Iraan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuuf waraana baay'ee bobbaasuu ykn injifatamuuf saaxilamuu gidduutti murtoo cimaa akka qabdu ibsameera.

title: India marks 80th Independence Day with military display
english: India celebrated its 80th Independence Day with a formal ceremony held at the iconic Red Fort in Delhi. Prime Minister Narendra Modi led the event by raising the national flag to commemorate the occasion. The festivities included a significant military parade to showcase the country's defense capabilities.
amharic: ሕንድ 80ኛውን የነጻነት በዓሏን በዴሊ ታሪካዊው ቀይ ምሽግ (Red Fort) በተከናወነ ልዩ ሥነ-ሥርዓት አክብራለች። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናሬንድራ ሞዲ ብሔራዊ ሰንደቅ ዓላማን በማውለብለብ በዓሉን መርተዋል። በዝግጅቱ ላይ የሀገሪቱን ወታደራዊ አቅም የሚያሳይ ሰልፍም ተካሂዷል።
oromo: Indiyaan guyyaa bilisummaa ishee 80ffaa magaalaa Deelii keessatti bakka seena-qabeessa ta'e 'Red Fort' jedhamutti kabajatteetti. Ministirri Muummee Naarendraa Moodiin alaabaa biyyattii ol baasuun sirnichaa gaggeessaniiru. Ayyaanichi agarsiisa waraanaa guddaa kan dabalate yoo ta'u, dandeettii ittisa biyyattii ifa godheera.

title: HRW says US civil rights enforcement reduced under Trump: What to know
english: A recent Human Rights Watch report reveals that the U.S. federal government has significantly weakened its civil rights enforcement during the start of President Donald Trump’s second term. The study highlights that key agencies tasked with preventing discrimination have suffered from severe staff shortages and a shift in government priorities. Consequently, experts warn that the administration is dismantling essential protections that vulnerable communities rely on for justice and equality.
amharic: የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅት (Human Rights Watch) ባወጣው አዲስ ሪፖርት መሠረት፣ በፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሁለተኛ የሥልጣን ዘመን መጀመሪያ ላይ የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ መንግሥት የዜጎችን መብት የማስከበር አቅሙ በእጅጉ ቀንሷል። ጥናቱ እንደሚያመለክተው አድልዎን ለመከላከል የተቋቋሙ ቁልፍ የመንግሥት ኤጀንሲዎች በሠራተኛ እጥረት እና በመንግሥት ቅድሚያ በሚሰጣቸው ጉዳዮች ለውጥ ምክንያት አቅማቸው ተዳክሟል። በዚህም ሳቢያ አስተዳደሩ የተቸገሩ ማህበረሰቦች ለፍትህ እና ለእኩልነት የሚጠቀሙባቸውን አስፈላጊ የጥበቃ ሥርዓቶች እያፈረሰ ነው የሚል ስጋት ተፈጥሯል።
oromo: Gabaasni dhaabbata mirga namoomaa (Human Rights Watch) akka ibsutti, jalqaba yeroo lammaffaa pirezidaantii Doonald Tiraampitti, mootummaan Yunaayitid Isteetis mirga lammiilee kabachiisuu irratti duubatti deebi’eera. Qorannoon kun akka agarsiisutti, dhaabbileen mirga lammiilee kabachiisuuf itti gaafatamummaa qaban, hir’ina hojjettootaa fi jijjiirama karoora mootummaa irraa kan ka’e dadhabanii jiru. Kana irraa kan ka’es, mootummaan kun hawaasni mirga isaanii mirkaneeffachuuf itti fayyadaman kan mancaasaa jiru ta’uu ogeeyyoonni akeekkachiisu.

title: Yemeni government says Houthi attack on al-Mokha killed four civilians
english: The Yemeni government reported that a Houthi ballistic missile strike on the Red Sea port of al-Mokha resulted in the deaths of four civilians. The attack, which involved six missiles, targeted local economic and maritime facilities, leaving eight other people injured. Additionally, two sailors remain missing following the incident.
amharic: የየመን መንግስት እንዳስታወቀው፣ ሁቲዎች በአል-ሞኻ ወደብ ላይ ባደረሱት ስድስት የባለስቲክ ሚሳኤል ጥቃት አራት ንፁሃን ዜጎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ጥቃቱ የኢኮኖሚ እና የባህር ላይ ተቋማትን ያነጣጠረ ሲሆን፣ ስምንት ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል። በተጨማሪም ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ ሁለት መርከበኞች የት እንዳሉ አልታወቀም።
oromo: Mootummaan Yemen akka beeksisetti, gareen Huthis buufata doonii Al-Mokhaa irratti xiyyaara killee waraanaa ja'a dhukaasuun lubbuu nagaa afur galaafateera. Miidhaan kun dhaabbilee diinagdee fi bakkeewwan qarqara galaanaa irratti kan xiyyeeffate yoo ta'u, namoonni saddeet ammoo miidhamaniiru. Kana malees, balaa kanaan walqabatee namoonni lama hanga ammaatti bakka bu'an hin beekamu.

title: Rashida Tlaib rally cancelled after Florida lawmaker calls its 'anti-jew'
english: A South Florida venue canceled a rally featuring U.S. Representative Rashida Tlaib following pressure from a state lawmaker who labeled the event as anti-Jewish. While Tlaib maintains that her criticism is directed at Israeli government policies rather than Jewish people, the facility cited security concerns and its commitment to the Jewish community as reasons for pulling out. This incident highlights ongoing tensions within the Democratic Party regarding how to address the conflict in the Middle East.
amharic: የደቡብ ፍሎሪዳ አዳራሽ አሜሪካዊቷ የኮንግረስ አባል ራሺዳ ትላይብ ሊሳተፉበት የነበረውን ስብሰባ፣ ዝግጅቱ አይሁድን የሚቃወም ነው በሚል የቀረበ ቅሬታ ተከትሎ ሰርዞታል። ትላይብ ትችታቸው በእስራኤል መንግስት ፖሊሲ ላይ እንጂ በአይሁድ ህዝብ ላይ አለመሆኑን ቢገልጹም፣ ዝግጅቱን አስተናጋጅ የሆነው ተቋም የጸጥታ ስጋትንና ለአይሁድ ማህበረሰብ ያለውን አቋም በመጥቀስ ዝግጅቱን ለመሰረዝ ወስኗል። ይህ ክስተት በዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ውስጥ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ጉዳይ ላይ ያለውን ልዩነት በግልጽ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Hoteelli tokko kan kibba Floridaatti argamu, miseensa Kongireesii Ameerikaa Rashida Tlaib irratti hirmaachuuf turte haquun isaa ibsameera. Kunis, miseensi mana maree naannichaa tokko walga'iin kun namoota Yihuudii kan mormu dha jechuun himannaa dhiyeessuun isaa hordofee kan dhufe dha. Tlaib akka jedhanitti, komiin isaan qaban siyaasa mootummaa Israa'el irratti malee saba Yihuudii irratti miti; ta'us, hoteellichi yaaddoo nageenyaa fi kabaja inni hawaasa Yihuudii qabuuf jechuun walga'icha haqeera. Ta'een kun, paartii Dimookiraatawaa keessatti dhimma waraana giddu galeessa bahaa irratti garaagarummaan yaadaa jiru akka itti fufu mul'isa.

title: Hamas likely to elect Gaza political bureau head next week, report says
english: Hamas is preparing to hold internal elections in the Gaza Strip next week to appoint a new leader for its local political bureau. Ali Al-Amoudi is currently the frontrunner for the position, succeeding Khalil Al-Hayya. Al-Amoudi, who previously worked closely with the late Yahya Sinwar, is recognized for his contributions to past ceasefire negotiations.
amharic: ሃማስ በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት በጋዛ ሰርጥ የሚገኘውን የፖለቲካ ቢሮ መሪ ለመምረጥ ውስጣዊ ምርጫ ለማድረግ እየተዘጋጀ ነው። አሊ አል-አሙዲ የሃሊል አል-ሃያን ቦታ በመተካት ለዚህ ኃላፊነት ዋና ተጠባቂ እጩ ሆነዋል። ከሟቹ የሃማስ መሪ ያህያ ሲንዋር ጋር በቅርበት ይሠሩ የነበሩት አል-አሙዲ፣ ከዚህ ቀደም በተደረጉ የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነቶች ላይ ጉልህ ሚና እንደነበራቸው ይታወቃል።
oromo: Hamas torbaan dhufu kana keessa biiroo siyaasaa Gaazaaf hogganaa haaraa filachuuf filannoo keessoo akka gaggeessu eegama. Namni bakka Khaalil Al-Hayyaa bu'uuf irra caalaa eegamaa jiru Alii Al-Amudii dha. Al-Amudiin hogganaa kanaan duraa Yahyaa Sinwaar waliin hojjechaa kan turan yoo ta'u, kanaan dura waliigaltee dhaabbiin waraanaa irratti gahee qaban.

title: Houthi spokesman says 'Saudi warships and mercenaries' targeted
english: Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree announced that the group conducted a ballistic missile strike against Saudi-led forces in the al-Mokha region. According to the rebels, the attack successfully destroyed enemy warships and military equipment. The statement further claimed that dozens of opposing fighters were killed or wounded during the operation.
amharic: የሁቲ ወታደራዊ ቃል አቀባይ ያህያ ሳሬ በአል-ሞካ አካባቢ በሚገኙ የሳውዲ ጥምር ኃይሎች ላይ የባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤል ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አስታውቀዋል። ቡድኑ ባወጣው መግለጫ ጥቃቱ የጠላትን የጦር መርከቦች እና መሳሪያዎች ሙሉ በሙሉ ማውደሙን ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም በዚህ ወታደራዊ ኦፕሬሽን በአስር የሚቆጠሩ የጠላት ኃይሎች መገደላቸውንና መቁሰላቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Dubbi himaan waraana Huthuu Yahyaa Saaree, weeraraa mishaayilii baalistii ta’e kan lafa al-Mokhaatti argaman humnoota Sa’udii fi ergamtootarratti raawwatamuusaa ibsan. Huthuuwwan akka jedhanitti, haleellaan kun dooniiwwan waraanaa fi meeshaalee diinaa barbadeessuu danda’eera. Gabaasichi, gocha kanaan loltootni diinaa hedduun ajjeefamuu fi madaa’uu isaanii himeera.

title: Hezbollah chief says Israel ‘only understands the language of force’
english: Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem argued that Israel only responds to military pressure, referencing the 2006 conflict as evidence. He explained that the group captured two Israeli soldiers at that time solely to negotiate the freedom of Lebanese prisoners held in Israeli jails. According to Qassem, this action was a final resort after all diplomatic attempts to secure their release had failed.
amharic: የሂዝቦላህ መሪ ናኢምቃሲም እስራኤል የምትገነዘበው የኃይል ቋንቋን ብቻ እንደሆነ ገልጸው፣ የ2006ቱን ጦርነት እንደ ማሳያ ጠቅሰዋል። የሁለት እስራኤላውያን ወታደሮች መያዝ የተፈፀመው በእስራኤል እስር ቤቶች የሚገኙ ሊባኖሳውያንን ለማስፈታት ብቻ እንደነበር ተናግረዋል። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረቶች ሁሉ ከከሸፉ በኋላ እንደሆነም አስረድተዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan Hizbolaah Na'iim Qaasim, Israa'el afaan humnaa qofa akka hubattu ibsuun, waraana bara 2006 akka ragaatti kaaseera. Raayyaan kun waraana Israa'el lama kan qabate, hidhamtoota Libaanoos mana hidhaa Israa'el keessa jiran furuuf qofa akka ta'e ibseera. Qaasim akka jedhetti, tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame erga tattaaffiin dipilomaasii hundi fashaleen booda dha.

title: US President Trump says he will declare Strait of Hormuz US territory
english: President Donald Trump announced his intention to designate the Strait of Hormuz as United States territory. However, experts note that this claim significantly exaggerates the actual level of American authority over this crucial international waterway. The statement has raised questions regarding international maritime law and the extent of US control in the region.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን የአሜሪካ ግዛት አድርገው እንደሚሰይሙ አስታውቀዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የዘርፉ ባለሙያዎች ይህ አገላለጽ በአለም አቀፍ የባህር መስመር ላይ ያለው የአሜሪካ ቁጥጥር አቅም የተጋነነ መሆኑን ይገልጻሉ። ይህ መግለጫ በአለም አቀፍ የባህር ህግ እና በአሜሪካ የቁጥጥር ወሰን ላይ ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Pirezedaantichi Donald Traamp daandii bishaanii 'Strait of Hormuz' jedhamu kan Ameerikaa akka ta'e labsuuf karoorfachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, ogeeyyonni akka jedhanitti, ibsi kun daandii idil-addunyaa kana irratti dhiibbaa Ameerikaan qabdu kan garmalee ol kaasee dubbate dha. Ibsi kun seera bishaanotaa idil-addunyaa fi hanga Ameerikaan naannichatti aangoo qabdu irratti gaaffii uumee jira.

title: Venezuela says 131 political prisoners freed amid post-Maduro talks
english: The Venezuelan government has released 131 political prisoners as part of a national reconciliation effort following the transition of power. While the United States and some opposition figures have welcomed this as a positive step, activists are calling for the immediate release of all remaining detainees. These releases follow recent negotiations between the government and the opposition, signaling a potential shift in the country's political climate.
amharic: የቬንዙዌላ መንግሥት ሥልጣን ሽግግርን ተከትሎ ብሔራዊ እርቅን ለማምጣት 131 የፖለቲካ እስረኞችን መፍታቱን አስታውቋል። የተወሰኑ የተቃዋሚ ፓርቲ አባላት እና የአሜሪካ መንግሥት ይህንን እርምጃ እንደ በጎ ጅምር ቢቀበሉትም፣ የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች ግን በእስር ላይ የሚገኙት ቀሪ እስረኞች በሙሉ በአስቸኳይ እንዲፈቱ እየጠየቁ ነው። እነዚህ ሰዎች የተፈቱት በመንግሥት እና በተቃዋሚዎች መካከል በተደረገው የድርድር ሂደት ማዕቀፍ ውስጥ ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Veenzuweelaa erga aangoon jijjiiramee booda biyya keessatti araara buusuuf jechuun hidhamtoota siyaasaa 131 gadhiiseera. Mootummaan Amerikaa fi qaamoleen mormituu tokko tokko tarkaanfii kana akka jalqaba gaariitti kan fudhatan ta'us, gareewwan mirga namoomaa hidhamtoonni hafan hundinuu dafanii akka gadhiifaman gaafachaa jiru. Gadi dhiifamuun hidhamtoota kanaa marii mootummaa fi mormituu gidduutti godhamaa jiru keessatti kan dhufe ta'uun ibsameera.

title: 7.7-magnitude earthquake strikes eastern Indonesia
english: A major 7.7-magnitude earthquake hit the eastern region of Indonesia, causing structural damage to buildings and forcing people to evacuate to safer areas. In response to the seismic activity, officials released a tsunami warning and are tracking ongoing aftershocks. The event has prompted significant concern for public safety in the affected coastal communities.
amharic: በኢንዶኔዢያ ምስራቃዊ ክፍል በሬክተር ስኬል 7.7 የሚያንቀጠቅጥ ኃይለኛ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ተከስቷል። በዚህ የተፈጥሮ አደጋ ህንጻዎች ላይ ጉዳት የደረሰ ሲሆን ነዋሪዎችም ወደ ከፍተኛ ቦታዎች እንዲሸሹ ተደርጓል። ባለስልጣናት የሱናሚ ማስጠንቀቂያ ያወጡ ሲሆን አደጋውን ተከትሎ የሚመጡ ተከታታይ የምድር ንዝረቶችን በመከታተል ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Indooneziyaa bahaatti kirkira lafaa cimaa hamma 7.7 ta'een buqqa'eera. Kirkirri kun miidhaa qabeenyaa geessiseera, akkasumas namoonni bakka tasgabbaa’aa ta’eetti akka baqatan dirqisiiseera. Aangoonni biyyattii akeekkachiisa suunaamii labsuun, kirkira lafaa itti aanuuf hordoffii taasisaa jiru.

title: Mangione pleads guilty as polarising CEO killing reaches new phase
english: Luigi Mangione has officially entered a guilty plea regarding the 2024 murder of Brian Thompson, the CEO of UnitedHealthcare. This high-profile killing sparked significant public debate and division regarding the state of the American health insurance industry. The legal case has now transitioned into a new stage following his admission of guilt for the federal charges.
amharic: ሉዊጂ ማንጊዮን የዩናይትድ ሄልዝኬር ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ብሪያን ቶምፕሰንን በ2024 በመግደሉ የቀረበበትን የፌደራል ክስ አምኖ ተቀብሏል። ይህ አነጋጋሪ ግድያ በአሜሪካ የጤና መድን ስርአት ላይ ከፍተኛ ቁጣን እና መከፋፈልን ፈጥሮ ነበር። ተከሳሹ ጥፋተኛነቱን መናገሩን ተከትሎ ክሱ ወደ አዲስ ምዕራፍ ተሸጋግሯል።
oromo: Luigi Mangione bara 2024 keessa ajjeechaa CEO UnitedHealthcare Brian Thompson irratti raawwateen himata federaalaa irratti dhiyaateef yakka isaa amaneera. Ajjeechaan kun sirna inshuraansii fayyaa Amerikaa irratti mufii fi wal-dhabdee guddaa umee ture. Amma himatamichi yakka isaa amanuu isaatiin wal-qabatee dhimmichi gara sadarkaa haarawaatti ce’eera.

title: Buenaventura residents criticise state neglect after Colombia’s earthquake
english: Residents of the Colombian port city of Buenaventura are criticizing the government for failing to provide adequate support following a powerful earthquake that caused significant destruction. Many homes have been ruined, local hospitals are struggling to treat the injured in outdoor tents, and citizens fear their community is being ignored in favor of wealthier cities. People are expressing frustration over the slow pace of official aid, noting that the disaster has highlighted a persistent history of state neglect in their region.
amharic: የኮሎምቢያዋ የቡዌናቬንቱራ ወደብ ነዋሪዎች በደረሰው አውዳሚ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ምክንያት የመንግስት ድጋፍ አለመኖር ቅሬታቸውን እያሰሙ ነው። በርካታ ቤቶች ወድመው የአካባቢው ሆስፒታሎች በቂ የህክምና አገልግሎት መስጠት ተስኗቸው በድንኳን ውስጥ ታካሚዎችን እያስተናገዱ ሲሆን፣ ነዋሪዎቹም መንግስት ለችግራቸው ትኩረት ባለመስጠቱ ያማርራሉ። ለችግሩ አፋጣኝ ምላሽ ባለመሰጠቱ፣ ነዋሪዎቹ አካባቢያቸው በመንግስት ለረጅም ጊዜ उप-ተረሳሽነት እንደተጋለጠ ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Namoonni magaalaa Buwenaventuuraa kan Kolombiyaa keessatti argamtu, kirkira lafaa cimaa booda mootummaan gargaarsa gahaa hin goone jechuun mormii dhageessisaa jiru. Manneen hedduun caccabanii, hospitaalonni bakkeetti dunkaana diriirsuun namoota miidhaman wal'aanuuf wal'aansoo gochaa jiru. Jiraattonni, mootummaan magaalota badhaadhoo ta'an caalaa magaalaasaanii akka tuffateefi gargaarsa hatattamaa akka hin goone dubbatu; kunis tuffii mootummaan naannicharratti waggoota hedduuf qabu kan agarsiisu ta'uu ibsatu.

title: Lula holds slim lead over Flavio Bolsonaro ahead of Brazil election
english: A recent poll indicates that Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva maintains a narrow lead over his right-wing rival, Flavio Bolsonaro, as the October presidential election approaches. The gap between the two candidates has tightened significantly, resulting in what is now considered a statistical tie. If no candidate wins an outright majority in the first round of voting, the top two contenders will face each other in a final run-off.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ የሕዝብ አስተያየት ውጤት እንደሚያሳየው የብራዚሉ ፕሬዚዳንት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ በጥቅምት ወር በሚካሄደው ምርጫ ከቀኝ ዘመም ተቀናቃኛቸው ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ ጋር ያላቸው የድምፅ ልዩነት መጥበቡን ያሳያል። ሁለቱ ተወዳዳሪዎች አሁን ካላቸው የድምፅ ክፍተት አንጻር ውጤታቸው በአኃዛዊ መረጃ እኩል እንደሆኑ ይቆጠራል። በማናቸውም እጩ የመጀመሪያውን ዙር ምርጫ በአብላጫ ድምፅ ማሸነፍ ካልቻሉ፣ ከፍተኛ ድምፅ ያገኙት ሁለቱ እጩዎች በሁለተኛ ዙር ይወዳደራሉ።
oromo: Qorannoon haaraan akka agarsiisutti, filannoo pirezidaantummaa biyya Brazil kan onkololeessa dhufu gaggeeffamuuf jiru irratti pirezidaant Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva fi morkataa isaanii kan mirgaa Flavio Bolsonaro gidduutti dorgommiin cimaan jiraachuu ibsameera. Walitti dhiheenyi sagalee dorgomtoota kana lamaanii gadi bu'uun isaa, amma dorgommiin isaanii walqixa ta'uu kan agarsiisuudha. Namni tokkollee yoo sagalee walakkaa ol hin arganne, dorgomtoota sagalee olaanaa argatan lamaan gidduutti qulqulleeffannaan lammaffaa kan gaggeeffamu ta'a.

title: UN urges support for Afghan women’s aid five years into Taliban rule
english: Five years after the Taliban returned to power in Afghanistan, UN Women has issued a warning that most local women's support organizations may soon close due to severe funding shortages. Officials report that humanitarian aid is significantly underfunded, leaving many groups unable to maintain their essential services for Afghan women. These women continue to face extreme restrictions on their education, employment, and daily movement under Taliban rule, leading to a major decline in their mental health and well-being.
amharic: ታሊባን ወደ ስልጣን ከተመለሰ አምስት ዓመታት ባስቆጠረበት በአፍጋኒስታን፣ የሴቶች መብት ተሟጋች ድርጅቶች በገንዘብ እጥረት ምክንያት ሥራቸውን ሊያቆሙ እንደሚችሉ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት አስጠንቅቋል። ለሰብአዊ እርዳታ የሚሰበሰበው ገንዘብ በቂ ባለመሆኑ፣ ብዙዎቹ ድርጅቶች አገልግሎታቸውን ለመቀጠል እየተቸገሩ ይገኛሉ። በታሊባን አስተዳደር ስር በአፍጋኒስታን የሚገኙ ሴቶች በትምህርት፣ በሥራ እና በነጻነት ላይ ከፍተኛ ገደብ ስለተጣለባቸው፣ የአእምሮ ጤናቸው እና የኑሮ ሁኔታቸው በእጅጉ እየተባባሰ መጥቷል።
oromo: Taaliban gara aangootti deebi'ee waggaa shan booda, dhaabbileen mirga dubartootaa Afganistaan keessa jiran baajata dhabuu irraa kan ka'e hojiin dhaabachuu danda'u jedhee Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akeekkachiiseera. Gargaarsi namummaa gahaa waan hin taaneef, dhaabbileen hedduun tajaajila dubartootaaf kennan itti fufuu dadhabaa jiru. Bulchiinsa Taaliban jalatti dubartoonni Afganistaan barnoota, hojii fi sochii irratti uggura cimaa waan qabaniif, fayyaan sammuu fi jireenyi isaanii ulfaataa ta'uun ibsameera.

title: Families angered by slow search for loved ones after Colombia quake
english: Families in Cali, Colombia are frustrated and demanding action as rescue efforts following a powerful 7.4 magnitude earthquake remain slow. Over 400 individuals are still missing beneath the debris, and the situation has become increasingly grim with reports of decaying remains. Relatives are calling for urgent help as the search for their loved ones continues to stall.
amharic: በኮሎምቢያ ካሊ ከተማ የደረሰውን የ7.4 ማግኒትዩድ የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ ተከትሎ የነፍስ አድን ስራው ዘገምተኛ በመሆኑ የተበሳጩ ቤተሰቦች ፈጣን እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ እየጠየቁ ነው። ከ400 በላይ ሰዎች ፍርስራሽ ውስጥ እንደጠፉ የሚገመት ሲሆን፣ የአስከሬን ሽታ መከሰቱም ሁኔታውን ይበልጥ አሳሳቢ አድርጎታል። ቤተሰቦች የጠፉባቸውን ወገኖች ለማግኘት የሚደረገው ጥረት እንዲፋጠን ጥሪያቸውን እያቀረቡ ነው።
oromo: Magala Cali, Kolombiya keessatti erga sochiin lafaa cimaan 7.4 mudatee booda, namoonni dhabamaniif tattaaffiin gargaarsa namoomaa suuta deemun maatiwwan dallansuu guddaa uumeera. Namoonni 400 ol ta'an caccabaa mana jala akka jiran himamaa jiraachuu fi fooliin reeffaa mul'achuun haalli sun daran ulfaataa ta'uu ibsameera. Maatiwwan jaallatamoon isaanii akka barbaadamanii fi hatattamaan gargaarsi akka godhamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Iran war live: Trump vows to make Hormuz US territory ‘pretty soon’
english: President Trump has threatened to declare the Strait of Hormuz as United States territory as part of a strategy to pressure Iran. The administration is also preparing significant new economic sanctions against the country. In response, Iranian officials have rejected the claim and stated they will maintain control over the waterway.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ኢራንን ለመጫን በሚያደርጉት ጥረት የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን የአሜሪካ ግዛት እንደሚያደርጉት አስፈራርተዋል። የአሜሪካ መንግስት በኢራን ላይ ከዚህ ቀደም ታይቶ የማይታወቅ ጠንካራ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ለመጣል እየተዘጋጀ ነው። ለዚህ ምላሽ የኢራን ባለስልጣናት የባህረ ሰላጤው የኢራን እንደሆነ እና በቁጥጥራቸው ስር እንደሚቆይ አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaant Traamp dhiibbaa Iiraan irratti uumuuf jechuun, Handhuura Hormuz (Strait of Hormuz) godaannisa Ameerikaa akka godhatan doorsisaniiru. Mootummaan Ameerikaa hanga ammaa kan hin mul'anne tarkaanfii diinagdee cimaa Iiraan irratti fudhachuuf qophaa'aa jira. Kanas hordofee, hoggantoonni Iiraan lafti sun kan isaanii ta'uu fi to'annoo isaanii jala akka turu dubbachuun mormaniiru.

title: Mangione admits killing healthcare CEO and pleads guilty to federal charges
english: Luigi Mangione has officially pleaded guilty in federal court to the murder of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson. He admitted to traveling across state lines and using a 3D-printed weapon to carry out the premeditated attack, which he claimed was motivated by his frustrations with the healthcare system. The 28-year-old now faces a potential life sentence, with a formal sentencing hearing set for mid-December.
amharic: ሉዊጂ ማንግዮን የዩናይትድ ሄልዝኬር ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ብሪያን ቶምፕሰንን እንደገደለ በፌዴራል ፍርድ ቤት አምኗል። ግለሰቡ ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው በጤና አጠባበቅ ስርዓቱ ላይ በነበረው ቅሬታ ምክንያት እንደሆነ በመግለጽ፣ 3D ፕሪንተር የተሰራ መሳሪያ በመጠቀም ጥቃቱን አስቀድሞ እንዳቀደው ተናግሯል። የ28 ዓመቱ ወጣት በህይወት ዘመን እስራት ሊቀጣ የሚችል ሲሆን፣ የቅጣት ውሳኔውም በታህሳስ ወር መጨረሻ ላይ ይሰጣል ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Luigi Mangione jedhamu qondaala olaanaa dhaabbata UnitedHealthcare Brian Thompson jedhaman ajjeesuu isaa mana murtiitti fudhateera. Inni kunis kan ta'e sababa sirna fayyaa irratti qabuun komii akka qabuufi miilaan biyyattii keessa deemee mi'a 3D-printeriin qophaa'e fayyadamuun akka isa ajjeese dubbateera. Dargaggeessi umriin isaa 28 ta'e kun hidhaa guutuu jireenyaa itti murteeffamuu kan danda'u yoo ta'u, murtii dhumaa ji'a Muddeetti kan dhaga'amu ta'a.

title: US aircraft carrier on way to relieve USS Lincoln after issues reported on board
english: The US Navy is sending the aircraft carrier USS George Washington to the Middle East to replace the USS Abraham Lincoln. The Lincoln has been on an extended nine-month deployment marked by reports of poor living conditions, food shortages, and sailors struggling with mental health. While families have expressed significant concerns about the well-being of the crew, the US government has downplayed these issues and stated that the current deployment is necessary.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል የ USS አብርሃም ሊንከን መርከብን ለመተካት USS ጆርጅ ዋሽንግተን የተሰኘውን አውሮፕላን ተሸካሚ መርከብ ወደ መካከለኛው ምስራቅ እየላከ ነው። የሊንከን መርከብ ለዘጠኝ ወራት በቆየው ረጅም ጉዞ ወቅት የምግብ እጥረት፣ የኑሮ ሁኔታ መባባስ እና የወታደሮች የአእምሮ ጤና መቃወስ እንደገጠማቸው ተዘግቧል። የቤተሰብ አባላት ስለ ወታደሮቹ ደህንነት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ቢገልጹም፣ የአሜሪካ መንግስት ግን እነዚህን ችግሮች በማጣጣል የቆይታ ጊዜው አስፈላጊ መሆኑን አስታውቋል።
oromo: Humnoonni galaana US meeshaa waraana xiyyara baatu USS George Washington gara giddu galeessa bahaatti erguun, USS Abraham Lincoln bakka buusuuf qophaa'aa jiru. Dooniin Lincoln baatii sagaliif bakka tokkotti tursiifamuusaa hordofee, hanqina nyaataa, rakkoo qulqullinaa fi jireenyaa akkasumas miira sammuu waraantootaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu isaa gabaasameera. Maatiin waraantootaa haala kana irratti yaaddoo guddaa qabaatanis, mootummaan US garuu rakkoolee kana xiqqeessuun yeroon kun dirqama ta'uu isaa ibseera.

title: Lebanon’s PM urges timetable for Israeli withdrawal as Hezbollah slams deal
english: Lebanese Prime Minister Nawaf Salam is demanding a specific timeline for Israeli forces to withdraw from Lebanon as part of ongoing ceasefire negotiations. While the government discusses these terms with U.S. officials, Hezbollah leader Naim Qassem has strongly criticized the approach, arguing it leaves the Lebanese army vulnerable to Israeli aggression and humiliation. Tensions remain high as officials push for a resolution while Hezbollah continues to question the effectiveness and safety of the proposed diplomatic framework.
amharic: የሊባኖስ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ናዋፍ ሳላም የእስራኤል ወታደሮች ከሊባኖስ ለቀው የሚወጡበትን ግልጽ የጊዜ ሰሌዳ እንዲቀመጥ እየጠየቁ ነው። መንግስት ከዩኤስ ባለስልጣናት ጋር ስለ ስምምነቱ እየመከረ ቢሆንም፣ የሂዝቦላህ መሪ ናኢምቃሲም የሊባኖስ ጦርን ለአደጋ እና ለውርደት የዳረገ ነው ሲሉ ውሳኔውን አጥብቀው ተችተዋል። በእስራኤል ጥቃት ሳቢያ እየተባባሰ ያለው ውጥረት የቀጠለ ሲሆን፣ ሂዝቦላህ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ ሂደቱ ውጤታማነት ላይ ጥርጣሬውን እያሰማ ነው።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Libaanoos Nawaaf Saalaam waraanni Israa'el biyya Libaanoos gadhiisee ba'uuf yeroo murtaa'e akka qabaatu gaafachaa jiru. Mootummaan mootummoota gamtoomaniin (US) waliin mari'achaa kan jiru ta'us, hogganaan Hizbullah Na'im Qaasim tarkaanfii kana mormuun, raayyaa ittisa biyyaa Libaanoos balaa fi salphinaaf saaxila jechuun balaaleffateera. Humnootni Israa'el kallattii garagaraan haleellaa geggeessaa waan jiraniif, mariin kun bu'aa qabaachuu isaa irratti shakkiiwwan ka'uun himameera.

title: Houthi attack on port kills four eroding truce with Yemen’s government
english: Houthi forces launched a ballistic missile strike on the government-controlled port of al-Makha, resulting in four fatalities and significant damage to the facility. This violent incident has severely damaged the 2022 truce agreement between the Houthis and the Yemeni government. The attack has sparked widespread concern that the country may return to a state of full-scale warfare.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን መንግስት ቁጥጥር ስር በሚገኘው አል-ማካ ወደብ ላይ ባደረሱት የባለስቲክ ሚሳይል ጥቃት አራት ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። ይህ ጥቃት በሁቲዎች እና በየመን መንግስት መካከል በ2022 የተደረሰውን የተኩስ አቁም ስምምነት ለአደጋ ዳርጓል። ድርጊቱ ሀገሪቱ ወደ ሙሉ ጦርነት ትመለሳለች የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humnoonni Huutii buufata doonii Al-Maakaa kan mootummaan Yaman to'atu irratti haleellaa misayilii raawwataniin namoota afur ajjeesaniiru. Haleellaan kun waliigaltee gadi dhiisuu waraanaa bara 2022 ifa ta'een cabsuun, biyyattii gara waraana bal'aa ta'etti deebisuu danda'a jedhamee sodaatamaa jira.

title: Yemen’s government says Houthi attack on al-Makha kills at least four
english: The Houthi movement recently carried out a series of ballistic missile strikes on the Yemeni port city of al-Makha, resulting in at least four deaths and significant property damage. The Yemeni government condemned the assault, noting that it targeted civilian areas and infrastructure. This escalation occurs amidst growing regional instability and a potential return to wider conflict within the country.

Mootummaan Yaman akka ibsetti, haleellaan kun buufata doonii fi qabeenya siivilii irratti kan xiyyeeffate ture. Wali dhabdeen kun Yaman keessatti waldhabdee hammaataa dhufe agarsiisa.

title: Hormuz traffic rises from nine to 13 crossings, Kpler says
english: Ship traffic through the Strait of Hormuz saw a significant 44% increase on August 13, reaching 13 total crossings. Most of these vessels utilized Iran’s specific transit arrangement rather than the standard international traffic lanes. Meanwhile, activity in the Bab el-Mandeb strait remained stable, and no new maritime attacks were documented by tracking authorities.

oromo: Guyyaa Hagayya 13, imalli dooniiwwanii gamoo Hormuz keessatti dhibbeentaa 44 ol guddatee, dooniiwwan 13 ta’an qaxxaamuraniiru. Dooniiwwan hedduun isaanii karaa idil-addunyaa fayyadamuu mannaa, karaa addaa kan Iiraan qopheessite hordofaniiru. Gamasa biraatiin, imalli dooniiwwanii gamoo Baab al-Mandab keessatti tasgabbaa’aa kan ture yoo ta’u, miidhaan dooniiwwanii haaraan tokkoyyuu hin gabaasne.

title: Araghchi says talks with Oman about Strait of Hormuz ‘may reach conclusion soon’
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi announced that ongoing technical negotiations with Oman concerning maritime navigation in the Strait of Hormuz are nearing a resolution. He clarified that these discussions involve military experts from both nations and are strictly focused on shipping routes. Furthermore, he emphasized that these talks are completely independent of any diplomatic negotiations regarding a ceasefire with the United States.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰላጤ የባህር ጉዞ ላይ ከኦማን ጋር እየተደረጉ ያሉ የቴክኒክ ድርድሮች ሊጠናቀቁ እንደሚችሉ ገልጸዋል። እነዚህ ውይይቶች በሁለቱ ሀገራት ወታደራዊ ባለሙያዎች መካከል የሚደረጉ እና በመርከቦች ማለፊያ መስመሮች ላይ ብቻ ያተኮሩ መሆናቸውን አስረድተዋል። እንዲሁም ድርድሩ ከአሜሪካ ጋር እየተደረጉ ካሉ የተኩስ አቁም ንግግሮች ጋር ምንም ግንኙነት እንደሌለው አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Iraan Abbas Araghchi, hariiroo galaana kan Hormuz irratti biyyattii fi Omaan gidduutti mariin teeknikaa ta'e gara xumuraatti dhiyaachaa akka jiru ibsan. Mariin kun gaggeessitoota waraanaa lamaanii fi qajeelfamoota dooniiwwan darban irratti kan xiyyeeffatu ta'uu ibsuun, kun immoo marii tasgabbii waraanaa Ameerikaa wajjin godhamu irraa adda ta'uu himaniiru.

title: Israeli settlers shoot and wound two Palestinians east of Hebron
english: Two Palestinian men were injured after being shot by Israeli settlers in the town of Bani Na’im, located near Hebron in the West Bank. Medical responders provided emergency care to the victims before transporting them to a hospital for further treatment. The injuries were sustained during a shooting incident that targeted the men in the al-Edisa area.

oromo: Naannoo Zoonii Lixaa magaalaa Hebronitti argamtu, Bani Na’im keessatti namoonni Palastayinii lama qe’ee buqqaatonni Israa’el bananiin dhukaasa irratti banameen miidhamaniiru. Dhaabbanni Gargaarsa Hamarrii Diimaa namoota miidhaman kana erga yaala ariifataa godhee booda gara hospitaalaatti geessuun yaalchiiseera. Dhukaasichi naannoo Al-Edisaatti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, namoota miidhaman kanneen irratti miidhaan qaamaa cimaan gahee jira.

title: UAE's Adnoc says one of its vessels came under attack while transiting Hormuz
english: The Abu Dhabi National Oil Company reported that one of its ships was attacked while traveling through the Strait of Hormuz on Friday. Fortunately, there were no injuries among the crew members involved in the incident. The company confirmed that the situation is currently stabilized and under control.
amharic: የአቡ ዳቢ ብሔራዊ የነዳጅ ኩባንያ (Adnoc) አርብ ዕለት በሆርሙዝ ባህር ሰርጥ ሲጓዝ የነበረ መርከባቸው ጥቃት እንደደረሰበት አስታወቀ። በደረሰው ጥቃት ማንኛውም የሰው ህይወት ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰ ኩባንያው ገልጿል። በአሁኑ ሰዓት ሁኔታው ቁጥጥር ስር መዋሉንና የተረጋጋ መሆኑን አክሎ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni boba’aa biyyoolessaa Abuu Daabii (Adnoc) akka ibsetti, markabni isaanii tokko guyyaa Jimaata darbe karaa galaana Hormuz yeroo darbu haleellaan irra ga’eera. Haleellaa kanaan miidhaan qaamaa namoota irra ga’e akka hin jirre ibsameera. Yeroo ammaa kana haalli jiru to’annoo jala akka jiru fi tasgabbaa’eera.

title: Iran's deputy foreign minister says won't be intimidated by US threats after Trump's statements on Hormuz
english: Iran's deputy foreign minister, Kazem Gharibabadi, stated that his country will not be frightened by Donald Trump's claims regarding the Strait of Hormuz. In response to the US President's suggestion to claim the waterway as American territory, Tehran insisted that it maintains full authority over the area. Officials emphasized that the strategic passage cannot be controlled through political rhetoric, social media posts, or military intimidation.
amharic: የኢራን ምክትል የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ካዚም ጋሪባባዲ የሆርሙዝን የባህር በር የዩናይትድ ስቴትስ ግዛት እንደሚያደርጉት የዶናልድ ትራምፕ መግለጫ ኢራንን ሊያስፈራራት እንደማይችል ገልጸዋል። ቴህራን በስልታዊው የውሃ መስመር ላይ ሙሉ መብት እንዳላት ያስታወቀ ሲሆን፣ አካባቢውን በፖለቲካ ንግግሮች ወይም በወታደራዊ ዛቻ መቆጣጠር እንደማይቻል አጽንኦት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Itti aanaan ministeera dhimma alaa Iraan Kaazim Gaariibaabaadii, yaada Doonaald Tiraamp kan dhiphina Hormuuz biyya isaanii jalatti galchuuf himan irratti Iraan sodaa tokko akka hin qabne ibsan. Teheraan daandiin bishaanii kun aangoo ishee jala akka jiru mirkaneessuun, daangaan kun haasaa siyaasaa ykn yaada miidiyaa hawaasummaan kan jijjiiramu miti jedhaniiru.

title: Iran has not decided on resuming US talks, Araghchi says
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi clarified that his country has not yet committed to restarting formal discussions with the United States. While officials from Qatar and Pakistan are currently facilitating the exchange of messages, these interactions do not constitute official negotiations. Consequently, no final decision regarding the restoration of diplomatic talks has been reached at this time.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር አባስ አራግቺ ሀገራቸው ከአሜሪካ ጋር ድርድር ለመጀመር እስካሁን ምንም አይነት ውሳኔ ላይ እንዳልደረሰች አስታውቀዋል። በኳታር እና በፓኪስታን በኩል መልእክቶች እየተለዋወጡ ቢሆንም፣ ይህ ሂደት ይፋዊ የድርድር አካል እንዳልሆነ ሚኒስትሩ ገልጸዋል። በመሆኑም በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ስለሚደረግ መደበኛ ውይይት እስካሁን የተወሰነ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Iraan Abbas Araghchi, biyyi isaanii marii Ameerikaa waliin deebisanii jalqabuuf hanga ammaatti murtoo tokkollee akka hin murteessine ibsaniiru. Biyyoonni akka Qaatar fi Paakistaan wal-xalayaa erguun giddu galeessa ta'anii hojjachaa jiranis, kun garuu marii seera qabeessa ta'e akka hin taane ibsameera. Kanaafuu, marii diippiloomaasii irratti hamma ammaa murtoon dhumaa irra hin gahamne.

title: Trump says he will declare Strait of Hormuz a US ‘territory’ amid Iran war
english: US President Donald Trump has announced his intention to designate the Strait of Hormuz as American territory following ongoing military conflicts with Iran. This vital maritime route, which is essential for global oil and gas transport, has become a central point of contention and renewed fighting between the two nations. This bold declaration is expected to further escalate tensions as current ceasefire negotiations remain stalled and ineffective.

oromo: Pirezedantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp, waraana Iiraan waliin jiru booda, harka keessa galchuun daandii bishaan Hormuz mootummaa Ameerikaa jalatti akka galchu beeksisaniiru. title: Israeli soldiers accused of supporting ‘terrorist’ settlers in Qusra
english: Israeli soldiers stationed in the West Bank village of Qusra are facing criticism for allegedly siding with extremist settlers. Reports indicate that troops were seen socializing with settlers while local Palestinians were being surrounded in their homes. An activist claims that instead of providing protection to the Palestinian residents, the military is enabling the hostile actions of these settlers.

oromo: Loltoonni Israa'el naannoo Qusraa kan West Bankitti argamu keessatti, jiraattotaan walitti bu'iinsa uumanii jiran namoota afuura weeraraa qaban waliin dhaabbataniiru jedhamanii himatamaa jiru. Loltoonni kun namoota qe'ee isaanii keessatti marsamanii jiranitti, qe'ee isaanii irratti weerara gaggeessaa kan jiran namoota waliin yeroo dabarsaa turan jedhamee gabaafameera. Aktivistoonni akka jedhanitti, loltoonni kunneen namoota naannichaa eeguu mannaa, gochaa hammeenyaa raawwattoota kanaa jajjabeessaa jiru.

title: Vance says low oil prices are top US goal in Iran conflict
english: Vice President JD Vance stated that the U.S. government's primary objective regarding the conflict with Iran is to maintain affordable fuel prices for American citizens. Preventing Iran from developing nuclear weapons is considered the administration's secondary goal. This perspective shifts the focus toward the importance of the Strait of Hormuz, differing slightly from President Trump's earlier emphasis on the nuclear issue as the sole priority.
amharic: ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ከኢራን ጋር በተፈጠረው ግጭት የአሜሪካ ዋናው ትኩረት ለዜጎቿ የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲረጋጋ ማድረግ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ኢራን የኑክሌር መሳሪያ እንዳታገኝ ማድረግ ደግሞ ሁለተኛው ቅድሚያ የሚሰጠው ጉዳይ ነው ብለዋል። ይህ አቋም ከፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ ቀደም ሲል ከነበረው የኑክሌር መከላከል ላይ ብቻ ያተኮረ ንግግር በተወሰነ መልኩ የተለየ ሲሆን፣ የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን የመቆጣጠርን አስፈላጊነት የሚያጎላ ነው።
oromo: Itti aantuun pirezidaantii JD Vance akka jedhanitti, kaayyoon guddaan mootummaan Ameerikaa walitti bu'iinsa Iraan waliin jiru keessatti qabu gatii boba'aa biyyattii keessatti gadi xiqqoo ta'ee akka turu gochuu dha. Iraan meeshaa niwukilaraa akka hin arganne taasisuun ammoo dhimma lammaffaarratti xiyyeeffannaa argate dha. Yaanni kun xiyyeeffannaa pirezidaant tiraamp duraan dhimma niwukilaraarratti qaban irraa adda bahee, to'annoo galaana Hormuz irratti xiyyeeffachuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Trump dismisses mental health concerns on USS Lincoln aircraft carrier
english: President Trump has rejected reports regarding the poor mental health and challenging conditions faced by sailors aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln. Despite lawmakers demanding an investigation into extended deployments and incidents involving sailors attempting to jump overboard, the administration maintains that the crew is well-supported. The ship has been at sea for a record-breaking period of over 250 days, but officials plan to replace the vessel soon.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በዩኤስኤስ አብርሃም ሊንከን የጦር መርከብ ላይ የሚገኙ መርከበኞች የገጠማቸውን የአእምሮ ጤና እና አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታዎች በተመለከተ የቀረቡትን ዘገባዎች ውድቅ አድርገዋል። የሕግ አውጪዎች መርከቧ ለረጅም ጊዜ በመሰማራቷ እና መርከበኞች ራሳቸውን ለመጉዳት ሙከራ ማድረጋቸውን ተከትሎ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ቢጠይቁም፣ አስተዳደሩ የጦር ኃይሉ አስፈላጊው ድጋፍ እንዳለው ይናገራል። መርከቧ ከ250 ቀናት በላይ በባህር ላይ በመቆየት ክብረ ወሰን ብትሰብርም፣ በቅርቡ በሌላ መርከብ ለመተካት ታቅዷል።
oromo: Pirezidaant Traamp gabaasawwan haala fayyaa sammuu fi rakkina hamaa namoonni doonii waraanaa USS Abraham Lincoln irra jiran keessa jiran ilaalchisee dhiyaate mormaniiru. Miseensonni mana maree dooniin tun yeroo dheeraaf bakka tokkotti dhaabbachuu dhabuu fi loltoonni doonii keessaa of darbachuuf yaaluun isaanii akka qoratamu gaafatanis, mootummaan garuu loltoonni deeggarsa gahaa akka qaban ibseera. Dooniin tun guyyoota 250 oliif galaana irra turuun seenaa hojii waraanaa keessatti galmeessiteerti, ta'us dhiheenyatti doonii biraatiin akka bakka buufamtu ibsameera.

title: Mount Etna eruption and volcanic ash shut Sicily’s busiest airport
english: Mount Etna's recent volcanic eruption has blanketed the area in ash, forcing the shutdown of Sicily’s Vincenzo Bellini Airport. With flight operations suspended until Saturday afternoon, hundreds of travelers are currently stranded during one of the year's busiest travel periods. Authorities have already dealt with significant flight cancellations and diversions, leading to increased pressure on alternative transportation services like trains.
amharic: የኤትና ተራራ በተከሰተው የእሳተ ገሞራ ፍንዳታ ምክንያት የወጣው አመድ የሲሲሊን ዋና አየር ማረፊያ ለጊዜው እንዲዘጋ አስገድዷል። የበረራ አገልግሎቶች እስከ ቅዳሜ ቀትር ድረስ በመታገዳቸው፣ በዓመቱ ከተጨናነቁ የጉዞ ወቅቶች በአንዱ ወቅት በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ መንገደኞች ተጉዘው መሄድ አልቻሉም። ባለስልጣናት ቀደም ሲል በርካታ በረራዎችን መሰረዛቸውን እና ማዘዋወራቸውን ተከትሎ፣ እንደ ባቡር ያሉ አማራጭ የትራንስፖርት አገልግሎቶች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና እየተፈጠረ ነው።
oromo: Dhukaati gaara Etna irraa ka'e daaraa baay'ee biyyoo waan haguugeef, buufanni xiyyaaraa guddaan Siisilii, Vincenzo Bellini, yeroof akka cufamu dirqisiiseera. Tajaajilli xiyyaaraa hanga guyyaa Sanbataa guyyaaatti waan dhaabbateef, namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman yeroo imalaatti rakkachuun dirqamaniiru. Bulchiinsi buufatichaa balalii hedduu haquu fi bakka biraatti erguu hordofee, dadhabbiin kun geejjiba biroo kanneen akka baaburaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumeera.

title: US has lost roughly 25 percent of its Reaper drones in Iran war: Report
english: A recent report indicates that the United States has lost approximately 25 percent of its MQ-9 Reaper drone fleet due to the ongoing conflict with Iran. This loss, valued at over $1.3 billion, suggests that Iran's air defense systems remain effective despite earlier government claims of their destruction. These drones, typically used for surveillance and precision strikes, are proving to be costly casualties in the current military engagement.
amharic: አዲስ የወጣ ዘገባ እንደሚያሳየው አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር ባላት ግጭት ምክንያት ወደ 25 በመቶ የሚሆነውን የMQ-9 ሪፐር ድሮን ክምችቷን አጥታለች። ከ1.3 ቢሊዮን ዶላር በላይ ዋጋ ያላቸው እነዚህ ድሮኖች መውደማቸው፣ የኢራን የአየር መከላከያ ስርአት ሙሉ በሙሉ ተደምስሷል የተባለው ቀደም ሲል የነበረው መግለጫ ትክክል እንዳልሆነ ያሳያል። ለመረጃ መሰብሰቢያ እና ለጥቃት የሚውሉት እነዚህ መሳሪያዎች በጦርነቱ ከፍተኛ ኪሳራ አስከትለዋል።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraa tokko akka ibsutti, Ameerikaan walitti bu'iinsa Iraan waliin jirtuun wal qabatee, dooniiwwan (drones) MQ-9 Reaper ishee keessaa harka 25 ol dhabdeetti. Kisaaraan dooniiwwan kanaa dolaara biliyoona 1.3 kan caalu yoo ta'u, kunis sirni ittisa qilleensaa Iraan guutummaatti barbadaa'eera jedhamee kan ture sobii ta'uu isaa agarsiisa. Dooniiwwan kunniin kan fayyadan basaasaa fi tarkaanfii sirrii ta'e fudhachuuf ta'us, waraana kana keessatti meeshaalee gatii guddaa qaban ta'uun isaanii mirkanaa'eera.

title: Former Cambridge professor accused of plagiarism found dead
english: Jason Arday, a prominent academic who made history as the University of Cambridge's youngest Black professor, has been found dead at age 41. His death occurred just nine days after he resigned from his position following serious allegations of plagiarism regarding his doctoral research. Although he acknowledged errors in his work, Arday denied being a fraud, and the university had been conducting an investigation into his academic record.
amharic: የካምብሪጅ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ታናሹ ጥቁር ፕሮፌሰር የነበሩት ጄሰን አርዳይ በ41 ዓመታቸው ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አርዳይ ከዶክትሬት ጥናታቸው ጋር በተያያዘ በቀረበባቸው የምርምር ስርቆት ክስ ምክንያት ከስራቸው ከለቀቁ ዘጠኝ ቀናት በኋላ ነበር የሞቱት። በስራቸው ላይ ስህተቶች እንደነበሩ ቢቀበሉም፣ በአጭበርባሪነት መከሰሳቸውን ውድቅ አድርገው የነበረ ሲሆን ዩኒቨርሲቲውም በአካዳሚክ ስራቸው ላይ ምርመራ እያደረገ ነበር።
oromo: Pirofeesarri dargaggeessiifi gurraachi Yuunivarsiitii Kaambirijii ta’anii seenaa hojjetan jeeson Arday, umrii waggaa 41tti du’anii argaman. Arday kan du’an, qorannoo doktooraatii isaanii irratti himata hatuu qorannoo (plagiarism) irratti dhiyaateen walqabatee hojiirraa erga gadi bahan guyyaa sagal booda dha. Hoji isaanii keessa dogoggorri akka jiru amanataniyyuu, himata sobaa fi hatuu qorannoo irratti dhiyaate kan morman yoo ta’u, yuunivarsiitiinis dhimma isaanii ilaalchisee qorannoo gaggeessaa ture.

title: Trump says he will 'soon' declare Hormuz strait US territory
english: During a rally in New York, Donald Trump announced plans to label the Strait of Hormuz as American territory following a potential victory over Iran. He shared this intention while discussing the ongoing conflict with the Iranian government. The statement was delivered to a crowd at a police academy event.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኒው ዮርክ ባደረጉት ስብሰባ ላይ ኢራንን ካሸነፉ በኋላ የሆርሙዝ ስትሬትን የአሜሪካ ግዛት አድርገው እንደሚሰይሙ አስታውቀዋል። ይህን ሀሳባቸውን የገለጹት ከኢራን ጋር ስላለው ግጭት በንግግር ላይ እያሉ ነው። መግለጫውንም በፖሊስ አካዳሚ በተዘጋጀ ዝግጅት ላይ ለታዳሚዎች ተናግረዋል።
oromo: Donald Trump walgahii New York irratti taasifame irratti, Iran injifachuu isaanii booda, lafa Hormuz (Strait of Hormuz) kan Ameerikaa akka ta'u akka labsan ibsaniiru. Yaada kana kan ibsan waa'ee waldhabdee biyyattii fi Iran irratti haasawaa turan irratti dha. Ibsa kana kan kennan manneen barnoota poolisii keessatti bakka namoonni hedduun argamanitti ture.

title: US has lost roughly 25 percent of its Reaper drones in Iran war: Report
english: A recent report indicates that the United States has lost approximately 25 percent of its MQ-9 Reaper drone fleet due to the ongoing conflict with Iran. These significant losses demonstrate that Iran's air defense capabilities remain effective, challenging earlier government claims. To address the resulting equipment shortages and high operational costs, the Trump administration is seeking billions in additional funding from Congress.
amharic: አዲስ የወጣ ሪፖርት እንደሚያመለክተው አሜሪካ ከኢራን ጋር በምታደርገው ጦርነት ምክንያት ወደ 25 በመቶ የሚጠጉ የMQ-9 ሪፐር ድሮኖቿን አጥታለች። እነዚህ ከፍተኛ ኪሳራዎች የኢራን የአየር መከላከያ አቅም አሁንም ውጤታማ መሆኑን የሚያሳዩ ሲሆን ከዚህ ቀደም ከመንግስት የተሰጡ መግለጫዎችንም የሚቃረኑ ናቸው። አስተዳደሩ የጦር መሳሪያ እጥረትን ለመቅረፍ እና የወጪዎችን ጫና ለመቋቋም ከኮንግረስ በቢሊዮን የሚቆጠር ተጨማሪ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እየጠየቀ ይገኛል።
oromo: Gabaasni haaraan tokko akka ibsutti, yeroo ammaatti Ameerikaan waraana biyyattii Iiraan wajjin gootuun walqabatee diroonota MQ-9 Reaper jedhaman keessaa harka 25 ol dhabdeetti. Kisaaraan kun kan agarsiisu humnoonni ittisa qilleensaa Iiraan ammas akka hojjataa jiran yoo ta'u, kunis ibsa mootummaan kanaan dura kenne faallessa. Mootummaan Trump miidhaa diroonota kanaa fi hanqina meeshaalee waraanaa furuuf akkasumas baasii waraanaa kanaa uwwisuuf, Kongiresirraa gargaarsa maallaqaa biliyoonaan lakka'amu gaafachaa jira.

title: US to hit Iran hard economically, Trump says
english: President Donald Trump announced that the United States plans to impose severe economic sanctions on Iran as the two nations remain at odds. This move follows a statement from Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who warned of unprecedented financial measures to be introduced next week. These actions are intended to increase pressure on Tehran amidst an ongoing six-month conflict.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ከፍተኛ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ለመጣል ማቀዷን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው የሁለቱ ሀገራት ግንኙነት ውጥረት ውስጥ ባለበት ወቅት ሲሆን የአሜሪካ የገንዘብ ሚኒስትር ስኮት ቤሰንት ከዚህ በፊት ታይቶ የማይታወቅ እርምጃ በሚቀጥለው ሳምንት እንደሚወሰድ ገልጸዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ለስድስት ወራት የዘለቀውን ግጭት ተከትሎ በኢራን ላይ የሚደረገውን ጫና ለመጨመር የታለመ ነው።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin Doonaald tiraamp akka jedhanitti, yeroo ammaa mootummaan isaanii Iran irratti tarkaanfii dinagdee cimaa fudhachuuf qophaa'aa jira. Ministirri maallaqaa Ameerikaa Sakoottii Beesant akka ibsanitti, tarkaanfiin kun kanaan dura kan hin mul'anne fi torban dhufu kan eegalu ta'a. Tarkaanfiin kunis walitti bu'iinsa ji'a ja'aaf ture dhaabsisuuf dhiibbaa Iran irratti godhamu kan cimsu dha.

title: Son of Mexico’s former president AMLO alleges US revoked his visa
english: Andres Manuel Lopez Beltran, the son of Mexico’s former president, claims that the United States government has revoked his visa. He criticized the decision as a politically driven move by U.S. officials and maintains that there is no legitimate evidence linking him to any criminal behavior. This incident occurs amid a wider U.S. effort to cancel visas for Mexican officials suspected of having connections to drug cartels.
amharic: የሜክሲኮ የቀድሞ ፕሬዝዳንት ልጅ አንድሬስ ማኑኤል ሎፔዝ ቤልትራን፣ የአሜሪካ መንግስት የመግቢያ ቪዛውን እንደሰረዘበት አስታውቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በፖለቲካዊ ተጽዕኖ የተደረገ መሆኑን የገለጸው ሎፔዝ ቤልትራን፣ ከማንኛውም የወንጀል ድርጊት ጋር ግንኙነት እንደሌለው በጽኑ ተከራክሯል። አሜሪካ ከዕፅ አዘዋዋሪዎች ጋር ግንኙነት አላቸው ብላ ለምትጠረጥራቸው የሜክሲኮ ባለስልጣናት ላይ እየወሰደች ካለው የቪዛ ስረዛ እርምጃ አንዱ አካል ነው ተብሎ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Ilmi pirezidaantii duraanii Meksikoo, Andres Maanu'el Loopeez Beltiraan, mootummaan Ameerikaa viizaa isaa haqee akka jiru beeksiseera. Innis tarkaanfichi dhiibbaa siyaasaa irraa kan madde akka ta'e ibsee, yakka tokko illee akka hin raawwanne hubachiiseera. Tarkaanfichi kan fudhatame yeroo mootummaan Ameerikaa namoota garee gurgurtaa sammuu namaa (cartel) waliin walqabatu jedhaman irratti viizaa haquu irratti bobba'eetti.

title: New aerial video reveals huge scale of oil spill off Oman
english: A grounded oil tanker off the coast of Oman is leaking sanctioned Russian crude, creating a massive environmental hazard. New aerial footage shows an oil slick covering approximately 2,000 square kilometers within a protected marine zone. The ship is carrying about one million barrels of oil, raising serious concerns about a potential ecological disaster in the region.
amharic: ኦማን የባህር ጠረፍ ላይ የቆመ አንድ የነዳጅ መጫኛ መርከብ የሩስያ ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ በመፍሰሱ ከፍተኛ የአካባቢ አደጋ ተጋርጧል። በአዲስ በተለቀቀው የአየር ላይ ምስል መሰረት፣ የነዳጅ መፍሰሱ በባህር ጥበቃ አካባቢ ወደ 2,000 ስኩዌር ኪሎ ሜትር የሚጠጋ ስፋት ላይ ደርሷል። መርከቧ በአጠቃላይ አንድ ሚሊዮን በርሜል ነዳጅ የያዘች በመሆኑ፣ በስነ-ምህዳሩ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ሊያደርስ እንደሚችል ተሰግቷል።
oromo: Markabni boba'aa Omaan biratti daangaa irraa badde tokko boba'aa Raashiyaa dhangalaasuun balaa naannoo guddaa uumee jira. Suurri samii irraa kaafame akka agarsiisutti, boba'aan dhangala'e kun naannoo qulqulluu ta'e keessatti bal'ina iskilomeetira iskuweerii 2,000 ga'uufi. Markabni kun boba'aa miliyoona tokko kan baatu ta'uun ishee, naannichatti miidhaa ekoloojii hamaa fiduu danda'a jedhamee sodaatamaa jira.

title: Afghan women tell the BBC their lives are unrecognisable after five years of Taliban rule
english: Five years after the Taliban returned to power in Afghanistan, women report that their lives have been completely transformed by severe new restrictions. Girls are now prohibited from attending school beyond the primary level, and women face strict limits on their movement and personal freedoms. Many residents express that their focus has shifted entirely to surviving poverty, as their hopes for education and professional careers have been shattered.
amharic: ታሊባን በአፍጋኒስታን ስልጣን ከተቆጣጠረ ከአምስት ዓመታት በኋላ፣ ሴቶች ህይወታቸው ሙሉ በሙሉ መቀየሩን ይናገራሉ። በአሁኑ ወቅት በአፍጋኒስታን ለሴት ህጻናት ከስድስተኛ ክፍል በላይ ትምህርት የተከለከለ ሲሆን፣ በሴቶች እንቅስቃሴና መብቶች ላይም ጠንካራ ገደቦች ተጥለዋል። ብዙዎቹ ሴቶች እንደገለጹት፣ ህልማቸውን እና ትምህርታቸውን ወደ ጎን በመተው በድህነት ውስጥ ለመትረፍ መታገል ዋነኛ አላማቸው ሆኗል።
oromo: Taalibaan Afgaanistaan erga to’atte waggaa shan booda, dubartoonni jireenyi isaanii guutummaatti jijjiiramuu himu. Yeroo ammaa biyyattii keessatti barumsi dubartootaa sadarkaa tokkoffaa olitti dhorkamee jira, akkasumas sochii fi mirgoota dubartootarratti daangaan cimaan kaa’ameera. Dubartoonni baay’een akka jedhanitti, abjuu fi barumsasaanii dhiisanii jiraachuuf qofa akka carraaqaa jiran ibsu; kunis hiyyummaa cimaa biyyattii keessa jiruun kan madde dha.

title: Trump asks US Supreme Court to allow $400m ballroom project to proceed
english: President Donald Trump’s administration has petitioned the Supreme Court to permit the continued construction of a $400 million ballroom at the White House. This request follows a lower court ruling that requires congressional approval for the project, which critics argue is an unauthorized use of taxpayer funds. The Department of Justice contends that the building project is essential for national security, despite ongoing legal challenges regarding its legality and historic impact.
amharic: የፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ አስተዳደር በኋይት ሀውስ እየተገነባ ያለውን የ400 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የዳንስ አዳራሽ ግንባታ እንዲቀጥል ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤትን ጠይቋል። ይህ ጥያቄ የቀረበው ግንባታው ያለ ኮንግረስ ፈቃድ መከናወን እንደሌለበት ዝቅተኛ ፍርድ ቤት ከወሰነ በኋላ ነው። የፍትህ ሚኒስቴር ፕሮጀክቱ ለሀገር ደህንነት ወሳኝ መሆኑን ቢገልጽም፣ ግንባታው ህገ-ወጥ እና የታክስ ከፋዮችን ገንዘብ የሚያባክን መሆኑን በመጥቀስ ብዙዎች እየተቃወሙት ይገኛል።
oromo: Bulchiinsi pirezidaant Donaald Traamp manni maree bakka raaqqisaa (ballroom) waggaa 400 miiliyoona kan ta'e kanneen Waayit Haaws keessatti ijaaramaa jiru akka itti fufuuf mana murtii olaanaa gaafate. Gaaffiin kun kan dhufe mana murtii gadii irraa hojiin kun eeyyama koongeerasiin alatti geggeeffamuu akka hin qabne murtaa'e booda. Ministeerri haqaa ijaarsi kun nageenya biyyaaf baay'ee barbaachisaa dha jedhee kan falmu ta'us, hirribni maallaqa gibira kaffaltootaa sirriitti akka hin fayyadamneefi heera mootummaa cabsuun shakkamee mormii guddaa keessa jira.

title: Woman charged over vandalism of World War II Memorial in Washington, DC
english: A 41-year-old woman named Melissa Farris has been arrested and charged with felonies for vandalizing the World War II Memorial in Washington, DC. Authorities claim she defaced the monument with graffiti and soap after a prior incident involving damage to the Reflecting Pool. If convicted, she faces a potential sentence of up to 10 years in prison for destroying the veterans' memorial.
amharic: ሜሊሳ ፋሪስ የተባለች የ41 ዓመት ሴት በዋሽንግተን ዲሲ በሚገኘው የሁለተኛው የዓለም ጦርነት መታሰቢያ ሐውልት ላይ ጉዳት በማድረሷ በቁጥጥር ስር ውላለች። ተጠርጣሪዋ በሐውልቱ ላይ ቀለም በመቀባትና ሳሙና በመጠቀም ጉዳት ማድረሷን ባለስልጣናት ገልጸዋል። ጥፋተኛ ሆና ከተገኘች፣ የጦር አርበኞች መታሰቢያን በማበላሸት እስከ 10 ዓመት የሚደርስ እስራት ሊፈረድባት ይችላል።
oromo: Dubartii umriin ishee 41 ta'e, Melissa Farris jedhamtu, yaaddannoo waraana lammata addunyaa kan Washington DC irratti miidhaa waan geessisteef qabamtee jirti. Qaamoleen nageenyaa akka jedhanitti, dubartiin kun yaaddannoo sana irratti barreeffama fi saamunaa fayyadamuun miidhaa geessisteetti. Yakka kana irratti kan itti murta'u yoo ta'e, yaaddannoo kabajamuu kana mancaasuu isheetiif hanga waggaa 10 hidhamaa itti murta'uu danda'a.

title: Art offers young Gaza survivors solace and escape from war’s devastation
english: Young Palestinians in Gaza are using art classes at a local beach cafe as a vital way to cope with the profound trauma of the ongoing war. By expressing their painful experiences through drawing, survivors like 16-year-old Maryam are finding a temporary escape from their difficult reality. These creative sessions provide the youth with a sense of relief, personal achievement, and a renewed feeling of hope during incredibly challenging times.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ወጣት ፍልስጤማውያን በጦርነቱ ምክንያት የደረሰባቸውን ከፍተኛ የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ ለመቋቋም የስዕል ጥበብን እንደ መጠለያ እየተጠቀሙ ይገኛሉ። እንደ ማርያም ያሉ ወጣቶች ስሜታቸውን በስዕል በመግለጽ ከጦርነቱ አስከፊ እውነታ ለአፍታም ቢሆን እፎይታን ያገኛሉ። እነዚህ የፈጠራ ስራዎች ወጣቶቹ ተስፋ እንዲሰንቁ እና ከባድ የህይወት ፈተናዎችን እንዲቋቋሙ የሚያግዝ ትልቅ መፍትሄ ሆኗል።
oromo: dargaggoonni Palasțayin Gaza keessa jiraatan waraana amma adeemaa jiruun miidhamaniif, fakkii kaasuu akka mala tasgabbii fi boqonnaatti fayyadamaa jiru. Dargaggoonni akka Maryam, miira isaanii fakkii irratti ibsuun haala rakkisaa keessa jiran irraa tasgabbii argachuu danda'aniiru. Walgahiiwwan uumamaa kun dargaggootaaf abdii fi jajjabina kennuun, rakkoo cimaa keessa darbaa jiran keessatti of ijaaruuf gargaaraa jira.

title: Italian police recover stolen paintings worth over $10m
english: Italian authorities have successfully recovered three valuable paintings worth over $10 million that were stolen from a museum near Parma in March. Police identified nine Moldovan nationals as suspects, with five of them believed to be directly involved in the rapid break-in. The recovered masterpieces include works by renowned artists Paul Cezanne, Pierre-Auguste Renoir, and Henri Matisse.
amharic: የጣሊያን ፖሊስ በመጋቢት ወር በፓርማ ከተማ አቅራቢያ ከሚገኝ ሙዚየም ተሰርቀው የነበሩ ከ10 ሚሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የሚያወጡ ሶስት ታዋቂ ሥዕሎችን ማግኘቱን አስታውቋል። በዝርፊያው ከተጠረጠሩ ዘጠኝ የሞልዶቫ ዜጎች መካከል አምስቱ በድርጊቱ በቀጥታ የተሳተፉ እንደሆኑ ተገምቷል። የተገኙት ሥዕሎች የፖል ሴዛን፣ የፒየር-ኦገስት ሬኖየር እና የሄንሪ ማቲሴ የጥበብ ስራዎች ናቸው።
oromo: Poolisiin Xaaliyaanii suuraawwan gatiin isaanii dolaara miliyoona 10 ol ta'u kan ji'a Bitootessaa keessa bakka kuusaa yaadannoo (museum) Parmaa biraa hatamanii turan deebisanii argachuu isaanii beeksisaniiru. Namoota biyya Moldoovaa sagal ta'an kanneen shakkaman keessaas, shanan isaanii karaa ifa ta'een haticha keessatti hirmaachuu isaanii poolisiin himera. Suuraawwan deebi'an kunneenis hojiilee ogummaa namoota beekamoo kanneen akka Pool Sezaan, Piyer-Oogasti Renoyar fi Henrii Maatis kan of keessatti qabataniidha.

title: Houthis say they targeted Aramco in Saudi Arabia's Najran with drone
english: Yemeni Houthi rebels have claimed responsibility for a drone strike against an Aramco oil facility located in the Saudi Arabian city of Najran. The group reported that the operation was successful in hitting its intended target. No further details regarding the extent of the damage or potential casualties were provided by the rebels.
amharic: የየመን የሁቲ አማጽያን በሳውዲ አረቢያ ናጅራን ከተማ በሚገኝ የአራምኮ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ላይ በድሮን ጥቃት ማድረሳቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ቡድኑ ጥቃቱ የታቀደለትን ግብ መታው ብሏል። ስለደረሰው ጉዳት ወይም ስለ ሰብዓዊ እልቂት ተጨማሪ መረጃ እስካሁን አልተገለጸም።
oromo: Warreen Houthi kan Yemen, magaalaa Najran kan Saudi Arabia keessatti buufata boba'aa Aramco irratti xiyyara gargaarsa malee (drone) fayyadamuun haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii ibsan. Gareen kun haleellaan kun kaayyoo isa ga'uu isaa beeksisaniiru. Haa ta'u malee, miidhaa qaqqabe ykn namoota miidhaman ilaalchisee odeeffannoon dabalataa hin kennamne.

title: CEO pay skyrockets in 2025 amid growing income inequality in the US
english: A new report reveals that the pay gap between US CEOs and their employees grew significantly in 2025, with top executives earning 312 times the average worker's salary. Tesla CEO Elon Musk represented a extreme outlier, earning millions of times more than his employees despite a decline in his company's sales and revenue. Labor experts warn that this massive income inequality may encourage executives to prioritize short-term personal gain over the long-term stability of their businesses and the economy.

title: Liverpool to sell minority stake to consortium including Jeff Bezos
english: Fenway Sports Group has agreed to sell a one-third minority stake in Liverpool FC to a group called 1892 Holdings, which includes Amazon founder Jeff Bezos. While the new partners will join the board and take on leadership roles, the current owners will retain majority control of the club. This partnership aims to support the team's long-term success as they begin their upcoming season.
amharic: የሊቨርፑል እግር ኳስ ክለብ ባለቤት የሆነው ፌንዌይ ስፖርትስ ግሩፕ፣ የአማዞን መስራች ጄፍ ቤዞስን ያካተተ 1892 ሆልዲንግስ ለተባለ ቡድን የክለቡን አንድ ሶስተኛ ድርሻ ለመሸጥ ተስማምቷል። አዲሶቹ ባለሃብቶች በክለቡ ቦርድ ውስጥ ቢካተቱም፣ የአሁኑ ባለቤቶች በክለቡ ላይ ዋናውን ቁጥጥር እንደያዙ ይቀጥላሉ። ይህ አጋርነት ክለቡ ለወደፊቱ የሚያስመዘግበውን ስኬት ለመደገፍ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Gareen kubbaa miilaa Liverpool abbaa qabeenyaa isaa kan ta'e Fenway Sports Group, garee 1892 Holdings jedhamuuf, kan keessatti hundeeessaan Amazon Jeff Bezos argaman, harka sadii keessaa tokko ($1/3$) gurguruuf waliigaltee irra ga'eera. Abbootiin qabeenyaa haaraan kun boordii klabichaa keessatti kan hirmaatan ta'us, abbootiin qabeenyaa amma jiran klabicharratti aangoo guutuu qabaachuudha itti fufu. Waliigalteen kun klabichi fuuldurattis milkaa'ina akka argatu gargaaruuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Trump asks Supreme Court to allow ballroom work to continue
english: President Trump has requested that the Supreme Court permit the continued construction of a $400 million White House ballroom despite a recent appeals court order to halt work. The administration argues that the facility is necessary for national security and large-scale events, and maintains that private funding eliminates the need for congressional approval. Legal opponents, including the National Trust for Historic Preservation, contend that the project violates regulations by bypassing mandatory reviews and public oversight.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በዋይት ሀውስ እየተገነባ ያለውን የ400 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የዳንስ አዳራሽ ግንባታ እንዲቀጥል ለጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ጥያቄ አቅርበዋል። የይግባኝ ሰሚ ፍርድ ቤት ግንባታውን እንዲያቆም ትዕዛዝ ቢሰጥም፣ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ፕሮጀክቱ ለሀገር ደህንነት እና ለትላልቅ ዝግጅቶች ወሳኝ በመሆኑ የግል ገንዘብ ስለሚጠቀም የፓርላማ ፈቃድ አያስፈልገውም በማለት ይከራከራል። የሀገሪቱን ታሪካዊ ቅርሶች ጠባቂ ድርጅትን ጨምሮ ሌሎች ተቃዋሚዎች ግን ፕሮጀክቱ ህጋዊ ምርመራዎችን እና የህዝብ ተሳትፎን የዘለለ በመሆኑ ስህተት ነው ይላሉ።
oromo: Pireezidaanti Traamp mana maree olaanaa irratti, ijaarsa daarii bal'aa mana mootummaa (White House) kan $400 miliyoona itti ba'aa jiru, ajaja mana murtii ol'iyyannoo irraa dhufeen alatti akka itti fufu gaafataniiru. Bulchiinsi isaanii, ijaarsi kun nageenya biyyaafis ta'e qophiiwwan gurguddaaf barbaachisaa dha, akkasumas maallaqni isaa kan dhuunfaa waan ta'eef hayyama mana maree seera baastuu hin barbaadu jedhaniiru. Gareewwan ijaarsa kana mormanis, ijaarsi kun adeemsa seeraa fi qorannoo barbaachisu hunda utuu hin hordofin jalqabame jechuun himatu.

title: Analysis: Israel’s government can’t disown West Bank settler violence
english: Rights groups and critics argue that the Israeli government is complicit in the ongoing settler violence against Palestinians in the West Bank. Although officials have publicly condemned recent attacks in Qusra, experts claim these statements are insincere because the military often protects or joins the settlers. Ultimately, analysts suggest that this state-supported aggression is part of a broader policy aimed at displacing Palestinians and annexing their land.
amharic: የሰብአዊ መብት ተሟጋቾች እና ተቺዎች የእስራኤል መንግስት በዌስት ባንክ በሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ላይ በሚፈጸም የሰፋሪዎች ጥቃት እጁ አለበት ብለው ያምናሉ። ባለስልጣናት በቅርቡ በቁስራ መንደር የተፈጸመውን ጥቃት በይፋ ቢያወግዙም፣ ወታደሮች ሰፋሪዎችን የሚከላከሉበት ወይም ከእነሱ ጋር አብረው የሚሰሩበት ሁኔታ በመኖሩ ውግዘቱ ተቀባይነት አጥቷል። በአጠቃላይ ይህ በመንግስት ድጋፍ የሚፈጸም ጥቃት ፍልስጤማውያንን ከቀያቸው ለማፈናቀል እና መሬታቸውን ለመውረስ የታቀደ የፖለቲካ አካሄድ መሆኑ ይነገራል።
oromo: Gumiiwwan mirga namoomaa fi qeeqonni akka jedhanitti, mootummaan Israa'el ganda Weest Baank keessatti weerartoonni (settlers) namoota Falasxiin irratti haleellaa raawwataniif itti gaafatamummaa qaba. Mootummaan haleellaa dhihoo kana ganda Qusraa keessatti raawwatame kan balaaleffate ta'us, loltoonni Israa'el weerartoota kana kan ittisan ykn isaan waliin kan hojjetan waan ta'eef qeeqonni kun soba jedhu. Walumaagalatti, haleellaan mootummaan deeggaramu kun, Falasxiinota qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqisuu fi lafa isaanii dhuunfachuu kan kaayyeeffate ta'uu isaa ogeeyyonni ni ibsu.

title: What’s next for far-right Reform UK after Farage’s by-election win?
english: Nigel Farage has secured re-election to the UK Parliament representing his party, Reform UK. However, the leader now faces significant uncertainty as an investigation into his financial dealings looms. This inquiry could potentially jeopardize his political career and negatively impact the party's future standing.
amharic: ናይጄል ፋራጅ የሪፎርም ዩኬ ፓርቲን በመወከል በድጋሚ ወደ ብሪታኒያ ፓርላማ ተመርጠዋል። ይሁን እንጂ የፓርቲው መሪ አሁን በፋይናንሻል ጉዳዮቻቸው ላይ እየተካሄደ ባለው ምርመራ ምክንያት ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ፈተና ተጋርጦባቸዋል። ይህ ምርመራ የፖለቲካ ህይወታቸውን ለአደጋ ሊዳርግ እና በፓርቲያቸው ላይ ተጽዕኖ ሊፈጥር እንደሚችል እየተነገረ ነው።
oromo: Naayjel Faaraaj paartii Reform UK bakka bu'uudhaan irra deebi'ee mana maree biyyattii (Parliament) keessatti filatameera. Ta'us, hogganaan kun amma qorannoo dhimma faayinaansii isaa irratti gaggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee rakkoo siyaasaa cimaa keessa galeera. Qorannoon kun gara fuulduraatti hojii isaa siyaasaa irratti dhiibbaa uumuu fi sadarkaa paartichaa miidhuu danda'a.

title: Philippines drug war victims seek justice through truth commission
english: Families of victims from the Philippines' former drug war are presenting testimonies to an independent truth commission to seek accountability for state-sanctioned killings. The commission is investigating thousands of deaths that occurred during Rodrigo Duterte's administration, often involving vigilante violence or police operations. Forensic experts are supporting these efforts by examining remains to uncover the truth behind these extrajudicial executions.
amharic: በፊሊፒንስ የቀድሞ የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ጦርነት ሰለባ የሆኑ ቤተሰቦች ለተፈጸሙት ግድያዎች ተጠያቂነትን ለማምጣት ለገለልተኛ የእውነት ኮሚሽን ምስክርነት እየሰጡ ነው። ኮሚሽኑ በሮድሪጎ ዱተርቴ አስተዳደር ወቅት የተፈጸሙ እና ብዙ ጊዜ በፖሊስ ወይም በታጣቂ ቡድኖች የተከናወኑትን በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ግድያዎችን እየመረመረ ነው። የፎረንሲክ ባለሙያዎችም በእነዚህ ሕገ-ወጥ ግድያዎች ዙሪያ ያለውን እውነታ ለማረጋገጥ የአስከሬን ምርመራ በማድረግ እየተባበሩ ነው።
oromo: Maatiin namoota duula farra qoricha sammua nama hadoochu kan durii Filippinsi keessatti ajjeefamanii, himata fi gaafatamummaa argachuuf komishinii dhugaa baasuu walaba ta'eef ragaa dhiyeessaa jiru. Komishinichi namoota kumaatamaan lakkaawaman yeroo bulchiinsa Rodrigoo Dutertee keessa ajjeefaman, kanneen polisii ykn garee hidhattootaan raawwataman qorachaa jira. Ogeeyyonni faayiniiwwan (forensic) reeffa qorachuun dhugaa ajjeechaa seeran ala raawwatame kana ifa baasuuf gargaarsa gochaa jiru.

title: Top French court upholds assisted dying law, rejects teen social media ban
english: France's highest court has approved a new law allowing assisted dying for patients suffering from incurable and terminal conditions under strict oversight. At the same time, the court rejected a separate government proposal that aimed to prohibit children under 15 from using social media, citing concerns over freedom of expression. These rulings represent a mixed outcome for President Macron, who had actively supported both legislative initiatives.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ከፍተኛ ፍርድ ቤት ሊታከም በማይችል ህመም ለሚሰቃዩ ታማሚዎች በልዩ ሁኔታ ህይወታቸውን በህክምና እንዲያጠፉ የሚፈቅደውን ህግ አጽድቋል። በተመሳሳይ መልኩ፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ ከ15 ዓመት በታች የሆኑ ህጻናት ማህበራዊ ሚዲያ እንዳይጠቀሙ የሚከለክለውን ሌላ ረቂቅ ህግ የመግለጽ ነፃነትን በመጥቀስ ውድቅ አድርጎታል። እነዚህ ውሳኔዎች ሁለቱንም ህጎች ሲደግፉ የነበሩት ፕሬዝዳንት ኢማኑኤል ማክሮን ድብልቅ ውጤት እንዲያገኙ አድርጓቸዋል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Faransaayi dhukkuba fayyuun hin danda'amneen kan dararamaa jiranuf haala addaa ta'een gargaarsa du'aa (assisted dying) heyyamuu seeraan raggaasiseera. Yeroo walfakkaatuu, mana murtichi daa'imman umriin isaanii waggaa 15 gadi ta'e miidiyaa hawaasummaa akka hin fayyadamne dhorkuuf yaalamee ture mirga yaada ibsachuu sarbuudhaan seera ala taasiseera. Murtiin kun Pirezidaant Imaanueeli Maakroon irratti kan hundaa'e ta'us, bu'aan isaa gama lamaan qabaachuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: Mangione pleads guilty to federal charges in UnitedHealthcare CEO killing
english: Luigi Mangione has officially pleaded guilty to federal charges regarding the 2024 assassination of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson. During the court appearance, Mangione admitted to researching and targeting the executive after posing as an investor to track his movements. While he has accepted responsibility for these federal crimes, he still faces separate state-level murder charges for which his original not-guilty plea remains active.
amharic: ሉዊጂ ማንግዮን በ2024 የዩናይትድ ሄልዝ ኬር ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ብሪያን ቶምፕሰንን በመግደል የወንጀል ክስ ጥፋተኝነቱን በፌዴራል ፍርድ ቤት አምኗል። ተከሳሹ የድርጅቱን መረጃ ለመሰብሰብ ባለሀብት መስሎ በመቅረብ ኢላማውን እንደጠበቀ በችሎት ተናግሯል። ምንም እንኳን በፌዴራል ክሱ ጥፋተኛነቱን ቢቀበልም፣ በክልል ደረጃ በቀረቡበት የነፍስ ማጥፋት ክስ ላይ ቀደም ሲል የገቡት የክህደት ቃል እንደፀና ነው።
oromo: Luwiiji Maangiyoonee bara 2024 ajjeechaa hoji geggeessaa olaanaa Yuunaytid Heelth Keer (UnitedHealthcare) Biriyaanii Toompsan irratti raawwatame ilaalchisee himata federaalaa irratti dhiyaateef yakka isaa amaneera. Mana murtiitti dhiyaatee akka ibsetti, namichi kun ragaa walitti qabachuuf akka invastaraatti of dhiyeessuun ajjeechaa kana akka karoorfate ibseera. Himata federaalaa kana irratti yakka isaa kan amane ta'us, himata ajjeechaa sadarkaa naannootti irratti banamee jiru irratti duraan waan mormeef, himatichi ammas itti fufa.

title: Qatar challenges AFC over open letter attacking FIFA President Infantino
english: The Qatar Football Association has formally challenged the Asian Football Confederation (AFC) for issuing a public letter against FIFA President Gianni Infantino without consulting its members. Qatar's football president stated that they were not informed or included in the decision to join UEFA and CONCACAF in calling for Infantino’s resignation. This dispute highlights significant internal disagreement within the AFC regarding the leadership crisis currently facing FIFA.
amharic: የኳታር እግር ኳስ ማህበር፣ የእስያ እግር ኳስ ኮንፌዴሬሽን (AFC) አባላቱን ሳያማክር በፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንት ጃኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ላይ የጋራ መግለጫ በማውጣቱ ቅሬታውን ገልጿል። የኳታር እግር ኳስ ፕሬዝዳንት እንደገለጹት፣ ከሌሎች ኮንፌዴሬሽኖች ጋር በመሆን ኢንፋንቲኖ ስልጣን እንዲለቁ ጥሪ በሚያቀርበው ደብዳቤ ላይ ለመስማማት ምንም አይነት ምክክር አልተደረገም። ይህ ክስተት በፊፋ አመራር ቀውስ ላይ የእስያ እግር ኳስ ኮንፌዴሬሽን አባላት መካከል ያለውን ከፍተኛ ክፍፍል ያሳያል።
oromo: Waldaan kubbaa miillaa Qatar, gamtaa kubbaa miillaa Eshiyaa (AFC) miseensota isaa osoo hin mariisisiin fiifa (FIFA) irratti ibsa waamicha gaafatu baasuu isaa mormeera. Pirezidaantiin waldaa kubbaa miillaa Qatar akka ibsanitti, pirezidaantiin FIFA Jaanii Infantiino aangoo gadhiisuu qabu kan jedhu ibsa irratti akkaataa itti murtaa'e irratti isaan hin hirmaanne akkasumas hin mariisifamne. Falmiin kun rakkoo hogganummaa FIFA irratti gamtaa AFC keessatti addaan ba'iinsi cimaan akka jiru ifa godha.

title: ‘The party of the Cubans’: How Republicans courted a key South Florida vote
english: Cuban Americans in South Florida continue to be a strong base of support for the Republican Party despite some recent local political changes. Analysts note that this long-standing loyalty was cultivated through decades of intentional political engagement and alignment with the community’s opposition to socialism. While immigration concerns exist, the Republican Party remains the preferred choice for most of this demographic heading into the upcoming midterm elections.
amharic: ምንም እንኳን በቅርቡ አንዳንድ የአካባቢ የፖለቲካ ለውጦች ቢኖሩም፣ በደቡብ ፍሎሪዳ የሚኖሩ ኩባዊ አሜሪካውያን ለሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ጠንካራ ድጋፍ መስጠታቸውን ቀጥለዋል። ተንታኞች እንደሚገልጹት፣ ይህ የረዥም ጊዜ ታማኝነት የተገነባው በአስርተ ዓመታት ውስጥ በተደረገ የፖለቲካ ትኩረት እና ማህበረሰቡ ሶሻሊዝምን በመቃወሙ ላይ የተመሰረተ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የስደተኞች ጉዳይ አሳሳቢ ቢሆንም፣ ለመጪው የመሃል ጊዜ ምርጫ አብዛኛው የዚህ ማህበረሰብ ክፍል አሁንም ሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲን መርጠዋል።
oromo: Haa ta'u malee, jijjiiramni siyaasaa naannoo tokko tokko mul'atus, lammiileen Ameerikaa jireenya isaanii kibba Florida jiraatan deeggarsa cimaa paartii Rippaabilikaanif kennuu itti fufaniiru. Akka ogeeyyiin ibsanitti, amanamummaan kun waggoota dheeraaf qophii fi xiyyeeffannoo siyaasaa akkasumas mormii hawaasichi sirna soshalizimii irratti qabuun kan dhufe dha. Dhimmi godaantotaa damdamii ta'us, baay'een isaanii filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa dhufuuf paartii Rippaabilikaan filatanii jiru.

title: Ahmed al-Sharaa: A New Vision for Syria
english: Following the collapse of the al-Assad regime in late 2024, Ahmed al-Sharaa, formerly known as Abu Mohammed al-Julani, has assumed the presidency of Syria. In a recent interview, he outlined his ambition to transition the nation toward a modern democracy while restoring its damaged international relationships and economy. He also emphasized his success in resolving tensions with the Kurdish community and stated that Syria will remain neutral regarding conflicts in Lebanon.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2024 መጨረሻ የአል-አሳድ አገዛዝ ከወደቀ በኋላ፣ ቀደም ሲል በአቡ መሐመድ አል-ጁላኒ ስም የሚታወቁት አህመድ አል-ሻራ የሶሪያ ፕሬዝዳንት ሆነው ተሹመዋል። በቅርቡ ባደረጉት ቃለ ምልልስ፣ አገሪቱን ወደ ዘመናዊ ዲሞክራሲ የመቀየር፣ የተጎዳውን ኢኮኖሚ የማገገም እና የውጭ ግንኙነቶችን የማሻሻል እቅዳቸውን አብራርተዋል። ከኩርድ ማህበረሰብ ጋር የነበረውን ግጭት በመፍታታቸው የተደሰቱ ሲሆን፣ ሶሪያ በሊባኖስ ግጭት ውስጥ ጣልቃ እንደማትገባም አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Dhuma bara 2024 sirni al-Assad erga kufee booda, namni kanaan dura Abu Mohammadi al-Julaanii jedhamanii beekaman Ahmed al-Sharaa pirezidaantii Sooriyaa ta’aniiru. Gaafii fi deebii taasisaniin, biyyattii gara dimokiraasii ammayyaatti ceesisuu, dinagdee miidhame suphuu fi hariiroo idil-addunyaa foyyeessuuf karoorasanii akka jiran ibsaniiru. Haawaasa Kurdii wajjin walitti bu'iinsa ture furuu isaanii kan ibsan yoo ta'u, Sooriyaan walitti bu'iinsa Liibaanoos keessatti harka akka hin qabaanne mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Kushner to visit Israel after Netanyahu rejects Gaza Board of Peace plan
english: Jared Kushner is planning to travel to Israel and Egypt alongside senior officials to discuss a U.S.-backed peace proposal for Gaza. This trip follows Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s rejection of the plan, specifically opposing terms that require Hamas to disarm and Israeli troops to withdraw. Despite the current impasse, international mediators and the Board of Peace remain focused on building a roadmap to finalize the agreement.
amharic: ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በጋዛ ቀጣይነት ያለው ሰላም ለማምጣት በአሜሪካ የሚደገፈውን የሰላም እቅድ ለመወያየት እስራኤል እና ግብፅ እንደሚሄዱ ተገልጿል። ይህ ጉብኝት የተዘጋጀው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ የሃማስን ትጥቅ መፍታት እና የእስራኤል ጦር ከጋዛ መውጣትን የሚያካትተውን እቅድ ውድቅ ካደረጉ በኋላ ነው። ምንም እንኳን የኔታንያሁ መንግስት እቅዱን ቢቃወምም፣ አለም አቀፍ አደራዳሪዎች እና የሰላም ቦርድ አባላት ስምምነቱን ለማሳካት የጋራ መፍትሄ ለመፈለግ እየሰሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Jared Kushner fi ogeeyyonni gurguddoon biroo karoora nageenyaa Gaazaaf qophaa'e irratti mari'achuuf gara Israa'el fi Misir akka imalan beekameera. Imalli kun kan qophaa'e muummichi ministeeraa Benjamin Netanyahu, gareen Hamas meeshaa waraanaa akka hiikuu fi waraanni Israa'el gaaza keessaa akka ba'u kan dirqisiisu karoora nageenyaa kana mormuu isaanii hordofee dha. Mootummaan Israa'el karoora kana mormus, walitti-fideeleen idil-addunyaa fi koreen nageenyaa waliigaltee kana milkeessuuf karaa furmaataa barbaadaa jiru.

title: Mutual defence: The alliances that preceded Turkiye-Pakistan-Saudi pact
english: Turkiye, Pakistan, and Saudi Arabia have established a new mutual defense pact that treats an attack on one member as an attack on all, mirroring NATO's collective defense principle. This alliance aims to strengthen military cooperation through joint exercises and deeper industrial partnerships amidst rising regional tensions. The agreement, which involves high-level coordination between defense and political officials, is also open for other nations to join in the future.
amharic: ቱርክ፣ ፓኪስታን እና ሳውዲ አረቢያ በአንዱ ላይ የሚሰነዘር ጥቃት በሶስቱም ላይ እንደተሰነዘረ የሚቆጠርበት አዲስ የጋራ መከላከያ ስምምነት ተፈራርመዋል። ይህ ጥምረት በክልሉ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የጸጥታ ችግር ለመቋቋም፣ የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶችን እና የጦር መሣሪያ ኢንዱስትሪ ትብብርን ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው። ስምምነቱ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ እና የፖለቲካ ባለስልጣናትን የሚያሳትፍ ሲሆን፣ ወደፊት ሌሎች ሀገራትም እንዲቀላቀሉበት ክፍት መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Turkiin, Paakistaanii fi Sa'udii Arabiyaan waliigaltee ittisaa haaraa kanneen keessaa tokko irratti haleellaan raawwatame hundasaanii irratti raawwatamee akka lakkaa'amu ibsu mallatteessaniiru. Walta'iinsi kun naannichatti rakkoolee nageenyaa mudataa jiranuuf deebii kennuuf, leenjii waraanaa waliinii fi guddina indaastirii ittisaa waliin cimsuuf kan karoorfame dha. Waliigalteen kun qondaaltota waraanaa fi siyaasaa sadarkaa olaanaa irratti argaman kan wal qunnamsiisu yoo ta'u, gara fuulduraatti biyyoonni biroon akka itti makamanis karaa banaa dha.

title: ‘De facto annexation’: Israel to shift civilian enforcement in West Bank from army to police
english: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz has ordered a plan to transition civilian law enforcement in the occupied West Bank from military to police authority. This policy shift aims to allow the army to focus exclusively on security and counter-terrorism, while police manage civil matters as they do within Israel. Critics view this move as a step toward the de facto annexation of the territory.
amharic: የእስራኤል መከላከያ ሚኒስትር እስራኤል ካትዝ በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት የሲቪል ህግ ማስከበር ስራን ከጦር ሰራዊት ወደ ፖሊስ የሚያሸጋግር እቅድ እንዲዘጋጅ አዘዋል። ይህ እርምጃ ጦሩ በፀጥታ እና በሽብርተኝነት ላይ ብቻ እንዲያተኩር ለማድረግ ያለመ ሲሆን ፖሊስ ደግሞ የሲቪል ጉዳዮችን እንዲመራ ያደርጋል። ተቺዎች ይህ የፖሊሲ ለውጥ ግዛቷን ለመቀላቀል የሚደረግ ግልጽ እንቅስቃሴ ነው ሲሉ ይተቹታል።
oromo: Ministirri ittisa biyyaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz, qindoomina seeraa naannoo Weest Baankiin to'annoo waraanaa jala jiru gara humna poolisiitti jijjiiruuf karoora akka qopha'u ajajaniiru. Jijjiiramni kun waraanni bakka tokko irratti xiyyeeffatee akka hojjetuuf yoo ta'u, poolisiin ammoo dhimmoota siivilii akka to'atu taasisa. Warri yaada kana morman, tarkaanfiin kun qabeenya biyyattii ofitti makachuuf karaa saaquudha jechuun ibsaniiru.

title: Kushner to visit Israel to discuss Trump's Gaza plan
english: Jared Kushner is traveling to Israel and Egypt to discuss a peace proposal for Gaza that was recently rejected by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The U.S. envoy aims to address concerns regarding the plan, which suggests Hamas disarm in exchange for a phased Israeli troop withdrawal. Despite ongoing tensions and military strikes, American officials remain focused on achieving the goal of a demilitarized Gaza.
amharic: ጃሬድ ኩሽነር በቅርቡ በጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ ውድቅ የተደረገውን የጋዛ የሰላም ዕቅድ ለመወያየት ወደ እስራኤል እና ግብፅ ያቀናሉ። የአሜሪካው ልዑክ ዕቅዱን በተመለከተ ያሉ ስጋቶችን ለመፍታት እና ሃማስ ትጥቁን እንዲፈታ በመጠየቅ የሰላም ሂደቱን ለማስቀጠል ይሞክራሉ። ምንም እንኳን በጋዛ ግጭቶች እና ጥቃቶች ቢቀጥሉም፣ አሜሪካ የጋዛን ትጥቅ ማስፈታት ዋና ግብ አድርጋ ትቀጥላለች።
oromo: Jaared Kushner karoora nagaa Gaazaatiif bahe kan muummicha ministeeraa Benjaamin Netaanyaahuun mormame irratti mari'achuuf gara Israa'el fi Gibxii imaluuf qophaa'aa jira. Ergamaan Ameerikaa kun yaaddoo dhiyaate irratti mari'achuun, gareen Hamaas hidhannoo hiikatee waraanni Israa'el akka gadi lakkisu taasisuuf carraaqqii godha. Giddu galeessa weeraraa fi walitti bu'iinsa ammaas, Ameerikaan Gaazaa hidhannoo hiiksisuun nagaa buusuuf xiyyeeffannoo kenniteetti.

title: ‘De facto annexation’: Israel to shift civilian enforcement in West Bank from army to police
english: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz has ordered a plan to transfer civilian law enforcement in the occupied West Bank from the military to the police. This shift aims to allow the army to focus exclusively on security and counter-terrorism, while police handle civilian matters as they do within Israel. Critics and observers suggest this move effectively treats the territory like an integrated part of Israel, furthering the process of de facto annexation.

Jijjiiramni kun waraanni xiyyeeffannaa isaa qofaa nageenyaa fi shororkeessummaa ittisuurratti akka godhatuufi, poolisiin immoo akka Israa'el keessaatti dhimmoota siviilii akka to'atuuf gargaara. Qeeqtonni tarkaanfiin kun naannicha guutummaatti biyyattii keessatti akka hammamuufi, dhugumaan biyya ofii godhachuu (annexation) akka ta'e dubbatu.

title: Video: Israel Katz inaugurates illegal new settlement in Jenin
english: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz officially opened a new settlement in Jenin on Thursday. This action took place immediately following the destruction of Palestinian-owned businesses and properties in the area. The establishment of this settlement is considered illegal under international law.
