oromo: Ministirri ittisaa Israa'el Israa'el Kaatz guyyaa Kamisaa magaalaa Jeeniin keessatti qubannaa haaraa seeraan alaa ta'e tokko eebbisuun bananiiru. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame waraanni Israa'el qabeenyaa fi suuqiiwwan warra Falasxiin erga diiganii booda dha. Hundeeffamni qubannaa kanaa seera idil-addunyaatiin kan hin hayyamamne fi seeraan alaa dha.

title: Instagram accounts fuelling Ceuta crisis with paid advice for help to cross
english: A BBC investigation has uncovered a network of Instagram accounts that are misleading migrants by portraying the dangerous swim from Morocco to the Spanish enclave of Ceuta as an easy and safe journey. These accounts target vulnerable individuals with promotional content and demand hundreds of pounds in exchange for deceptive advice on how to cross the border. This activity has significantly contributed to a massive surge in migration, ignoring the reality that many people have tragically drowned while attempting these illegal routes.
amharic: የቢቢሲ ምርመራ እንደሚያሳየው ከሞሮኮ ወደ ስፓኒሽ ግዛት ሱታ በባህር የሚደረገውን አደገኛ ጉዞ ቀላል እና አስተማማኝ አድርገው የሚያሳዩ የኢንስታግራም አካውንቶች ተበራክተዋል። እነዚህ አካውንቶች ሰዎችን በማታለል ድንበር እንዴት ማቋረጥ እንደሚቻል የሐሰት ምክር ለመስጠት ከሰዎች ከፍተኛ ገንዘብ ይጠይቃሉ። ይህ ድርጊት በርካታ ሰዎች አደገኛውን መንገድ እንዲመርጡ በማድረግ ለሞት እና ለከባድ አደጋ እየዳረጋቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Qorannoon BBC akka agarsiisutti, imala balaa qabu kan Marookoo irraa gara magaalaa Ceuta jedhamtuutti namoonni daakuun ce'uun salphaa fi nageenya kan qabu ta'uu ibsuun olola sobaa babal'isu. Gareen kun namoota gowwoomsuun daangaa ce'uuf gorsa sobaa kennuudhaan maallaqa hedduu gaafatu. Gochi kun namoonni hedduun karaa balaa qabu kana akka filatan gochuudhaan lubbuun isaanii akka darbuufi miidhaa hamaa irra akka ga'an sababa ta'eera.

title: Builders unearth €9m gold loot sealed in walls of Belgian property
english: Construction workers renovating a home in Belgium recently discovered a massive stash of gold bars and coins worth approximately 9 million euros hidden inside the basement walls. The treasure was found during plumbing work, and the site is now under police protection while officials investigate who will legally own the findings. The property is currently owned by a charity, and under Belgian law, there is a five-year window for any potential rightful owners to come forward.

title: Pakistan PM’s ‘red line’ warning to India over water treaty
english: Pakistan's Prime Minister, Shehbaz Sharif, has issued a stern warning to India, describing the country's water resources as a critical boundary that must not be crossed. He accused the Indian government of violating the Indus Waters Treaty and declared that Pakistan is prepared to address any future provocations. This statement highlights the ongoing diplomatic friction between the two nations following their military conflict in May 2025.

Paakistaan rakkoolee gara fuulduraatti mudachuu danda'an kamiyyuu akka deebistu kan ibsan yoo ta'u, haasaan kun waldhabdee waggaa 2025 waraana booda biyyoota lamaan gidduutti uumame kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Russia stance will be defended in court, pledges World Athletics chief Coe
english: World Athletics President Sebastian Coe has vowed to personally defend the organization's ongoing ban on Russian and Belarusian athletes at the Court of Arbitration for Sport. The Russian athletics federation is legally challenging the sanctions, arguing they are politically motivated and unfair. Despite other sports bodies relaxing their rules, Coe insists the ban is necessary to protect the integrity of competition rather than being a political statement.

title: US missionary kidnapped in Niger released after nine months in captivity
english: Kevin Rideout, an American pilot working for a missionary group, has been freed after being held captive for over nine months in Niger. He was abducted by armed men in Niamey last October and is now in the custody of U.S. officials. While specific details regarding his release remain undisclosed, reports suggest he was held by a militant group active in the region.

oromo: Pilaotii Ameerikaa kan ta'an Kevin Rideout, erga ji'oota sagalii ol biyya Niijaritti butamanii turanii booda nagaatti gadhiifaman. Haala itti gadhiifaman ilaalchisee odeeffannoon bal'aan hin kennamne malee, hidhattoota naannichatti socho'an harka akka turan ni himama.

title: Saudi Arabia announces start of Red Sea defence alliance: Will it work?
english: Saudi Arabia has officially launched a new multinational maritime defense alliance involving 13 countries to protect key shipping routes in the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden. Member nations plan to enhance regional security by sharing intelligence, conducting joint naval exercises, and coordinating military operations. While 13 nations have completed the formal process, more countries are expected to join this open coalition in the near future.
amharic: ሳዑዲ ዓረቢያ በቀይ ባህር እና በአደን ባህረ ሰላጤ አካባቢ የሚደረገውን የንግድ መርከቦች ጉዞ ለመጠበቅ 13 አገራት ያካተተ አዲስ የባህር ኃይል ጥምረት በይፋ መስርታለች። የአባል አገራቱ የመረጃ ልውውጥ በማድረግ፣ የጋራ ወታደራዊ ልምምዶችን በማካሄድ እና የባህር ላይ ስራዎችን በማስተባበር የክልሉን ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ አቅደዋል። ይህ ጥምረት ለሌሎች አገራትም ክፍት በመሆኑ ተጨማሪ አባላት በቅርቡ እንደሚቀላቀሉት ይጠበቃል።

Biyyoonni miseensa ta’an odeeffannoo waljijjiiruun, leenjii waraanaa waloo gaggeessuun akkasumas hojiiwwan galaanaa waliin qindeesuun nageenya naannichaa eeguuf karoorfataniiru. Walta’iinsi kun biyyoota biroofis kan baname waan ta’eef, gara fuulduraatti biyyoonni biroon itti makamu jedhamee eegama.

title: Iraq says daily oil exports at highest level since start of war
english: Iraq's oil ministry announced that daily oil exports have reached two million barrels since the start of August. This marks the highest export volume recorded since the regional conflict involving Iran and the U.S. began affecting the Strait of Hormuz. These figures highlight a significant recovery in Iraq's oil trade despite ongoing geopolitical tensions.
amharic: የኢራቅ የነዳጅ ሚኒስቴር ከነሐሴ ወር መጀመሪያ አንስቶ የዕለት ተዕለት የነዳጅ ኤክስፖርት ወደ ሁለት ሚሊዮን በርሜል ማደጉን አስታውቋል። ይህ የኤክስፖርት መጠን በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለው ግጭት የሆርሙዝን የባህር ወሽመጥ ከዘጋው ጊዜ ወዲህ ከፍተኛው ነው። ይህም በክልሉ ባለው የፖለቲካ ውጥረት ውስጥ የኢራቅ የነዳጅ ንግድ መሻሻልን ያሳያል።
oromo: Ministeerri boba'aa Iraaq akka ibsetti, jalqaba ji'a Hagayyaa irraa eegalee biyyattiin guyyaatti boba'aa miliyoona lama gabaa biyya alaa ergaa jirti. Kunis, waraanni Iran fi Ameerikaa gidduutti ka'eefi buufata Hormuz cufuun isaa erga jalqabee as, gabaa kana keessatti sadarkaa ol aanaa dha. Lakkoofsi kun rakkoolee siyaasaa naannichatti jiran keessa iyyuu, daldalli boba'aa Iraaq fooyya'uu isaa agarsiisa.

title: AIPAC spent millions to unseat me. Here’s why they’re now losing: Ex-congressman | Jamaal Bowman
english: Former Congressman Jamaal Bowman claims that the lobbying group AIPAC spent significant funds to remove him from office. Despite these efforts, he argues that the influence of such organizations is beginning to decline. Bowman believes that his experience highlights a growing shift in political sentiments regarding how outside groups impact election outcomes.
amharic: የቀድሞው የኮንግረስ አባል ጀማል ቦውማን፣ የሎቢ ቡድኑ AIPAC ከስልጣን ለማውረድ ከፍተኛ ገንዘብ እንዳወጣ ገልጸዋል። ይህ ጥረት ቢደረግም፣ እንደዚህ አይነት ድርጅቶች ያላቸው ተፅእኖ እየቀነሰ መምጣቱን ይከራከራሉ። ቦውማን የደረሰበት ጉዳይ የውጭ አካላት በምርጫ ውጤቶች ላይ ያላቸው ተፅእኖ እየተቀየረ መምጣቱን ያሳያል ብለው ያምናሉ።
oromo: Miseensi koongresii duraanii Jamaal Bowmaan, gareen dhiibbaa uumu AIPAC jedhamu isa aangoo irraa buusuuf maallaqa guddaa akka baase ibsaniiru. Carraaqqiin kun godhamus, dhiibbaan dhaabbilee akkasii gadi bu'aa akka jiru himu. Bowmaan muuxannoon isaa kun jijjiirama siyaasaa fi dhiibbaan gareewwan alaa bu'aa filannoo irratti qaban xiqqachaa akka dhufe akka mul'isu amanu.

title: Iran formalises Strait of Hormuz control as US struggles to sustain war it launched with Israel
english: Iran's parliament has taken initial steps toward implementing a strategic plan that would grant the country greater control over the Strait of Hormuz. Under these new regulations, Iran intends to block maritime traffic from nations it views as adversaries, specifically the United States and Israel. This move comes as regional tensions remain high and the US faces difficulties managing the ongoing conflicts in the Middle East.
amharic: የኢራን ፓርላማ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት ላይ የሀገሪቱን ቁጥጥር ለማጠናከር የሚያስችል ስትራቴጂካዊ እቅድ የመጀመሪያ ምዕራፍ አጽድቋል። በዚህ እቅድ መሰረት ኢራን እንደ አሜሪካ እና እስራኤል ያሉ ጠላት ብላ የምትፈርጃቸው ሀገራት መርከቦች በባህር መስመሩ እንዳያልፉ ለመከልከል አቅዳለች። ይህ ውሳኔ በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ውጥረት ባየለበት እና አሜሪካ በክልሉ የምታደርገው ተሳትፎ በተፈተነበት ወቅት የተወሰደ ነው።
oromo: Paarlaamaan Iraan daandii bishaan galaana Hormuz irratti to'annoo cimaa gochuuf karoora tarsiimawaa ta'e tokko raggaasiseera. Karoora kanaan, Iraan biyyoota akka Ameerikaa fi Israa'el kanneen isheen diina jette amantuuf qaxxaamura galaanichaa dhorkuuf karoorfateetti. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame yeroo waldhabdeen naannichaa hammaatee fi Ameerikaan rakkoowwan naannoo kanaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa keessa jirtutti.

title: 'Mayfair means money': A walk through the Gulf elite's favourite part of London
english: Dubai's ruler, Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, faced public protests during his visit to London over the UAE's alleged role in the war in Sudan. The confrontation occurred near a luxury shopping district in Mayfair, an area popular with wealthy Gulf residents and investors. While some visitors from the UAE defend their government's actions, the incident highlights the ongoing tensions surrounding foreign involvement in the Sudanese conflict.

oromo: Bulchaan Dubaay, Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, yeroo London daawwatanitti waraana Sudaan keessatti gahee UAE qabduun walqabatee mormiifi balaaleffannaan isaan mudateera. Mormiin kun kan mudate naannoo Mayfair kan dureeyyoonni biyyoota Gulf itti boqotanitti. Namoonni UAE irraa dhufan tokko tokko gocha mootummaa isaanii kan ittisan yoo ta'u, taateen kun immoo gowwummaa fi waldhabdee waraana Sudaan keessatti hirmaannaa alagaa waliin walqabatee jiru ifa godheera.

title: Israeli soldiers prevent aid delivery to besieged Palestinians
english: Israeli military forces have blocked humanitarian activists from reaching Palestinian residents in the West Bank village of Qusra. These villagers have been effectively trapped in their homes by local settlers for almost a week. Efforts to provide essential aid to the besieged community have been unsuccessful due to the military intervention.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በዌስት ባንክ ኩስራ መንደር የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያንን ለመርዳት የሄዱ አክቲቪስቶችን አግደዋል። መንደሩ ለሳምንት ያህል በአካባቢው ሰፋሪዎች ተከቦ ነዋሪዎቹ ከቤታቸው እንዳይወጡ ተደርገዋል። በወታደሮቹ ጣልቃ ገብነት ምክንያት አስፈላጊውን እርዳታ ለተከበቡት ነዋሪዎች ማድረስ አልተቻለም።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el gargaarsa namoomaa gara baadiyaa Qusraa kan West Bankitti argamu geessuuf yaalii ta'e ugguranii jiru. Jiraattoonni baadiyaa kanaa torban tokkoof godaantota naannichaan marfamanii mana isaanii keessatti haala rakkoo keessa jiru. Duula kana sababeeffachuun, waraanni kun gargaarsa barbaachisaa ta'e jiraattota marfaman kanaaf akka hin geenye dhorkanii jiru.

title: Israeli forces block activists from reaching besieged Qusra families
english: Israeli forces have blocked activists from delivering essential food and water to around 15 Palestinians, including children, who have been trapped in their homes by settlers in the West Bank town of Qusra for nearly a week. The military declared the area a closed zone and removed international aid workers, leaving the residents without electricity or water. Fearing their property will be seized, the families have refused orders to abandon their homes despite ongoing harassment from settlers.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በአይሁድ ሰፋሪዎች ለሳምንት ያህል በዌስት ባንክ ቁስራ ከተማ የታገዱ 15 ፍልስጤማውያን (ህጻናትን ጨምሮ) እርዳታ እንዳይደርስላቸው ከልክለዋል። ሰራዊቱ አካባቢውን የተከለከለ ወታደራዊ ቀጠና በማወጅ አጋዥ ሰራተኞችን ከቦታው ያባረረ ሲሆን ቤተሰቦቹም ያለ ውሃ እና ኤሌክትሪክ እንዲቆዩ ተገደዋል። ነዋሪዎቹ ቤታቸውን እንዳያጡ በመስጋት ወታደሮቹ ቦታውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ የሰጡትን ትእዛዝ ለመቀበል ፈቃደኛ አልሆኑም።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el maatiiwwan Palesxinaa 15 ta'an, kanneen ijoollee dabalatu, magaala Qusraa keessatti torban tokkoof qubattoota Israa'eliin marfamanii jiranuf gargaarsa nyaataa fi bishaanii akka hin geenye dhorkaniiru. Waraanni Israa'el naannicha bakka waraanaa cufaa ta'e jechuun gargaartota alaa ari'eera, kunis maatiiwwan kun ibsaa fi bishaan malee akka hafan godheera. Maatiiwwan kunneen manni isaanii akka hin fudhatamne sodaachuun, ajaja naannicha gadi lakkisanii akka bahaniif kenname didaniiru.

title: Rising Australian golfer Bang dies of brain haemorrhage in Thailand aged 18
english: Rising Australian professional golfer Jessica Bang has passed away at the age of 18 following a brain haemorrhage. She collapsed while in Thailand to compete in a qualifying tournament and failed to recover after undergoing emergency surgery. The golf community and her family are mourning the loss of the talented teenager who recently celebrated her first professional victory.
amharic: አውስትራሊያዊቷ ታዳጊ ፕሮፌሽናል ጎልፍ ተጫዋች ጀሲካ ባንግ በአንጎል ደም መፍሰስ ምክንያት በ18 ዓመቷ ከዚህ ዓለም በሞት ተለየች። በታይላንድ ውድድር ላይ ለመሳተፍ ተዘጋጅታ በነበረችበት ወቅት በድንገት በመውደቋ በአስቸኳይ ቀዶ ጥገና ተደርጎላት ነበር። ሆኖም ህይወቷን ማትረፍ ባለመቻሏ የጎልፍ ስፖርት ቤተሰቦች እና ቤተሰቦቿ በታላቅ ሀዘን ላይ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Taphattuun golfii Ostraaliyaa beekamtii argachaa turte Jessica Bang, dhibee dhiiga sammuu keessatti dhangala'uun umurii waggaa 18tti du'uun ishee dhaga'ameera. Isheen erga Taayilaanditti dorgommii golfiif qophaa'aa jirtuu tasa kukkuftee booda, baqaqsanii hodhuu (surgery) hatattamaa erga godhamtee boodas lubbuun ishee darbeera. Hawwaasni ispoortii golfii fi maatiin ishee, dargaggeettii goota kanaa ta'e kana erga darbee booda gadda cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Huckabee calls Israeli settlers ‘terrorists’: Can US push end Qusra siege?
english: US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee has taken a rare and firm stance by labeling Israeli settlers who besieged three Palestinian families in the West Bank village of Qusra as terrorists. The settlers had trapped the families, including a US citizen, cutting off essential supplies like water and electricity in an attempt to seize their property. Following US intervention, Israeli forces were deployed to remove the settlers, marking a significant and unusually strong condemnation of settler violence by a high-ranking US official.

oromo: Ambaasaaddarri Ameerikaa gara Israa'elitti ergaman Maayik Haakabii, godina Weest Baank ganda Qusraa keessatti maatiiwwan Falasxiin sadii irratti weerara gaggeessaa turan qaxaleewwan Israa'el 'shororkeessitoota' jechuun balaaleffataniiru. Qaxaleewwan kunneen maatiiwwan Ameerikaa dabalatee jiran bakka tokkotti ugguruun, bishaanfi elektirikii dhaabuun qabeenya isaanii saamuuf yaalii godhaniiru. Mootummaan Ameerikaa dhiibbaa waan godheef, waraanni Israa'el qaxaleewwan kana naannichaa akka gadi lakkisan gochuun isaanii, namni sadarkaa olaanaa irra jiru tokko gocha kana bifa kanaan balaaleffachuun isaa baay'ee kan nama ajaa'ibu ta'eera.

title: Russia's UN envoy says Hormuz navigation 'ruined' by US
english: Russian UN diplomat Mikhail Ulyanov has accused the United States of destabilizing the Strait of Hormuz through its aggressive stance toward Iran. He argues that Washington’s policies have undermined the freedom of navigation in the region rather than protecting it. Ulyanov claims that the U.S. is now attempting to resolve the resulting regional tension by escalating conflict, which he describes as a flawed strategic approach.
amharic: የሩሲያ የተባበሩት መንግስታት ተወካይ ሚካሂል ኡሊያኖቭ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምታደርገው ጠበኛ አካሄድ በሆርሙዝ ስትሬት አካባቢ ያለውን የባህር ጉዞ ነፃነት እንዳናጋው ተችተዋል። ዋሽንግተን የባህር ጉዞ ነፃነትን እፈልጋለሁ ብትልም፣ በራሷ ስህተት የፈጠረችውን ቀውስ በጦርነት ለመፍታት መሞከሯ ተገቢ አለመሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ዲፕሎማቱ የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ስትራቴጂያዊ ስህተት የተሞላበት መሆኑን ይከራከራሉ።
oromo: Bakka bu'aan Raashiyaa kan Tokkummaa Mootummootaa Mikhail Ulyanov, Amerikaan gara Iraniitti kan qabdu tarkaanfii cimaan kun karaa galaana Hormuz irratti tasgabbii dhabsiiseera jechuun komataniiru. Washington bilisummaa daandii galaana sanaa kabachiisuu barbaaddus, rakkoon amma uumame sun dogoggora kanaan dura isheen raawwatte irraa kan dhufe ta'uu ibsaniiru. Ulyanov, Amerikaan dogoggora ofii ishee sirreessuuf jecha waraana babal'isuun filannoo sirrii miti jechuun cimsanii balaaleffataniiru.

title: Palestinians in West Bank village remain under Israeli settler siege for sixth day
english: Palestinian families in the village of Qusra have been trapped for nearly a week as Israeli settlers occupy the area around their homes. The settlers have disrupted essential services like water and electricity, effectively isolating the residents. Although the Israeli military is present in the area, they have reportedly failed to intervene, leaving the families without access to necessary food or medical supplies.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ ኩስራ መንደር የሚገኙ የፍልስጤም ቤተሰቦች እስራኤላዊ ሰፋሪዎች ቤታቸውን በመክበባቸው ላለፉት ስድስት ቀናት በከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ። ሰፋሪዎቹ የውሃ እና የኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦቶችን በመቁረጣቸው ነዋሪዎቹ የምግብ እና የሕክምና ዕርዳታ ማግኘት ተስኗቸዋል። የእስራኤል ወታደሮች አካባቢው ቢደርሱም፣ ሰፋሪዎቹን ከማስወገድ ይልቅ አብረዋቸው ሲታዩ በመታየቱ ቤተሰቦቹ አሁንም በከፍተኛ አደጋ ውስጥ ናቸው።
oromo: Maatiin Falasxiin kan baadiyyaa Qusra jiraatan, guyyoota ja’an darbanif naannoo manasaaniitti marsaa qonnaan bultoota Israa’el jalatti kufanii jiru. Qonnaan bultoonni kunneen bishaanifi elektirikii irraa kutuun, maatiiwwan kun nyaataafi qoricha argachuu akka hin dandeenye godhaniiru. Waraanni Israa’el bakka sana kan gahan ta’us, qonnaan bultoota kana achi baasuun hafee isaan wajjiin yeroo dabarsaa waan jiraniif, maatiiwwan kun rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Iran formalises Strait of Hormuz control as US struggles to sustain war it launched with Israel
english: Iran has officially moved toward controlling the Strait of Hormuz by approving a strategic plan that allows it to block ships from nations it considers hostile, including the US and Israel. This development comes as the US threatens to impose historic economic sanctions to counter Tehran's influence in this critical energy corridor. Meanwhile, Iran is actively seeking to bypass these pressures by pursuing deeper ties with international financial groups like the Brics-backed New Development Bank.
amharic: ኢራን የሆርሙዝን የባህር በር ለመቆጣጠር የሚያስችል ስልታዊ እቅድ በማጽደቅ፣ እንደ አሜሪካ እና እስራኤል ያሉ ጠላት ብላ የምትፈርጃቸው አገራት መርከቦች ወደ አካባቢው እንዳይገቡ ከልክላለች። ይህ እርምጃ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ ታይቶ የማይታወቅ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ ለመጣል ስታስፈራራበት በነበረበት ወቅት የተከናወነ ነው። በምላሹም ኢራን በአሜሪካ ከሚመሩ የፋይናንስ ተቋማት ውጪ አማራጭ የኢኮኖሚ ግንኙነቶችን ለመፍጠር ከብሪክስ አገራት ጋር በቅርበት እየሰራች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Iiraan daandii bishaan galaana Hormuz to'achuuf karoora tarsiimawaa raggaasisteetti; kunis biyyoota akka Ameerikaa fi Israa'el kanneen diina ishee ta'an jedhamanirraa markaboonni daandicha fayyadamuu akka hin dandeenye kan taasisuudha. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame yeroo Ameerikaan Iiraanirratti tarkaanfii dinagdee cimaa fudhachuuf doorsisaa jirtutti. Gama biraatiin, Iiraan dhiibbaa kana dandamachuuf jecha, dhaabbilee faayinaansii addunyaa kan akka New Development Bank kan Brics waliin hariiroo cimaa uummachuuf carraaqqii gochaa jirti.

title: Man City tight-lipped on Rodri transfer amid Barcelona and Real Madrid link
english: Manchester City manager Enzo Maresca has declined to clarify the future of midfielder Rodri amid growing transfer rumors involving Barcelona and Real Madrid. Speculation intensified after Rodri was photographed on a flight from Madrid to England, though reports suggest Real Madrid may be priced out of a potential move. Maresca emphasized that while the transfer window remains active, his primary focus is preparing the team for the upcoming Community Shield match against Arsenal.
amharic: የማንቸስተር ሲቲው አሰልጣኝ ኢንዞ ማሬስካ ከባርሴሎና እና ሪያል ማድሪድ ጋር ስሙ የተያያዘው አማካዩ ሮድሪ ስለሚኖረው የወደፊት ዕጣ ፈንታ ግልጽ መግለጫ ከመስጠት ተቆጥበዋል። የዝውውር መስኮቱ ክፍት በመሆኑ ማንኛውም ነገር ሊከሰት እንደሚችል የገለጹት አሰልጣኙ፣ ሮድሪ ከማድሪድ ወደ እንግሊዝ ሲጓዝ መታየቱ ውዝግብ ቢፈጥርም ትኩረታቸው አርሰናልን በሚገጥሙበት የኮሚዩኒቲ ሺልድ ጨዋታ ላይ ብቻ እንደሆነ አስታውቀዋል። ሮድሪ ከቀዶ ጥገና በኋላ ወደ ልምምድ የተመለሰ ቢሆንም ስለ ዝውውሩ እስካሁን የተረጋገጠ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Leenjisaan Manchestir Siti Inzo Maareskaa, gabaasota gabaa dabarsuu keessatti maqaan Roordirii ka'aa jiru ilaalchisee yaada kennuu irraa of qusataniiru. Roordiriin Maadiriid irraa gara Ingilizitti osoo deemaa jiruu kaameraan qabamuun isaa shakkii guddaa uumee kan jiru yoo ta'u, Maareskaan garuu xiyyeeffannaan isaa guutuu tapha kaappii 'Community Shield' kan Arsenal wajjin taphatamu irratti akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Gabaasni tokko tokko akka ibsanitti, gatiin gabaa taphatichaa ሪያል Maadiriid dura dhabuu danda'a jedhamee yaadama.

title: US threatens ‘indefinite’ blockade against Iran: How long can it last?
english: The United States has pledged to maintain an indefinite naval blockade on Iran and plans to implement unprecedented economic sanctions to isolate the country. Despite US claims of control, the Strait of Hormuz remains closed by Iranian authorities, effectively halting maritime traffic in the area. Meanwhile, there are growing internal concerns regarding the well-being of American sailors stationed on the USS Abraham Lincoln due to the prolonged deployment.
amharic: አሜሪካ በአይራን ላይ የጣለችውን የባህር ላይ እገዳ ላልተወሰነ ጊዜ እንደምትቀጥል እና አገሪቱን ለማግለል ታይቶ የማይታወቅ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀብ እንደምትጥል አስታውቃለች። የአሜሪካ መንግስት የሆርሙዝ ባህረ ሰላጤን እንደቆጣጠረ ቢገልጽም፣ ኢራን በአሁኑ ወቅት የባህር መስመሩን ዘግታ በመያዟ በዚያ አካባቢ የንግድ መርከቦች እንቅስቃሴ ተቋርጧል። በሌላ በኩል፣ ረጅም ጊዜ በፈጀው ዘመቻ ምክንያት በአሜሪካ የጦር መርከብ ላይ ያሉ መርከበኞች የጤና እና የደህንነት ሁኔታ አሳሳቢ ሆኗል።
oromo: Amerikaa qarqara galaana Iranitti kan kuffiste ugguraa galaanaa gara fuulduraatti yeroo hin murtoofneef akka itti fufsiistu fi Iran addunyaa irraa addaan baasuuf tarkaanfii dinagdee cimaa fudhachuuf karoorfatteetti. Mootummaan Amerikaa daandii galaana Hormuz to’annaa isaa jala akka jiru ibsuus, Iran daandii sana cuftee waan jirtuuf sochiin dooniiwwanii adda citee jira. Gama biraatiin, yeroo dheeraa fudhachuu duula kanaatiin walqabatee haalli jireenyaa fi nageenyaa loltoota doonii Amerikaa ‘USS Abraham Lincoln’ irra jiran yaaddoo keessa seenee jira.

title: Russian ballistic attacks intensify as Kyiv claims Dnipropetrovsk advance
english: Ukraine has successfully recaptured 26 settlements in the Dnipropetrovsk region, regaining control over significant territory from Russian forces. Despite this military progress, Russia has ramped up its missile and drone attacks on major Ukrainian cities, causing civilian casualties and infrastructure damage. The ongoing conflict remains intense as Ukraine struggles to defend against these strikes while continuing its counteroffensive operations.
amharic: ዩክሬን በዲኒፕሮፔትሮቭስክ ክልል 26 ሰፈሮችን በተሳካ ሁኔታ መልሳ መቆጣጠር ችላለች። ይህ ወታደራዊ ስኬት ቢኖርም ሩሲያ በዩክሬን ዋና ዋና ከተሞች ላይ የሚሰነዝረውን የሚሳኤል እና የድሮን ጥቃት አጠናክራ ቀጥላለች። ጥቃቱ በዜጎች ላይ ጉዳት እና በታችኛው መዋቅር ላይ ውድመት እያስከተለ ሲሆን፣ ዩክሬን በአንድ በኩል የመልሶ ማጥቃት ዘመቻዋን በሌላ በኩል የራሷን መከላከያ ለማጠናከር እየታገለች ትገኛለች።
oromo: Yukireeniin naannoo Diiniiprooppetiroovsk keessatti ganda 26 irra deebitee to'annaa ishee jala galchiteetti. Milkaa'ina waraanaa kana ta'us, Raashiyaan magaalota gurguddoo Yukireen irratti rukuttaa mizaayilii fi doroniin raawwattu daran cimsiteetti, kunis miidhaa lubbuu fi mancaatii qabeenyaa geessiseera. Yukireeniin gama tokkoon lola ishee itti fufee fi gama biraan immoo miidhaa kana ofirraa ittisuuf qabsaa'aa jirti.

title: Record-breaking rain in Japan leaves several dead, thousands stranded
english: Historic rainfall in Japan's Chiba prefecture has led to severe flooding, resulting in at least four deaths and one missing person. Authorities have issued evacuation orders for over 400,000 residents as flood risks persist. Although the intense rain is subsiding, the region remains under alert for ongoing dangers.
amharic: በጃፓን ቺባ ግዛት የጣለው ከፍተኛ ዝናብ ባስከተለው የጎርፍ አደጋ ቢያንስ አራት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ አንድ ሰው ደግሞ የደረሰበት አይታወቅም። የጎርፍ አደጋው ስጋት በመቀጠሉ ከ400,000 በላይ ነዋሪዎች ከቤታቸው እንዲለቁ ትዕዛዝ ተላልፏል። ምንም እንኳን ዝናቡ እየቀነሰ ቢመጣም፣ በክልሉ ያለው አደጋ አሁንም ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Bokkaan roobee hin beekne naannoo Chiibaa Jaappaaniitti roobeen balaa lolaa hammaataa fideen namoonni afur lubbuun isaanii darbeera, namni tokkos badeera. Balaan lolaa waan jiruuf namoota 400,000 ol ta'aniif ajajni gadi ba'uu kennameera. Goolli bokkaa hir'atuus, balaan lolaa naannichatti waan jiruuf of eeggannoon cimaan taasifamaa jira.

title: Palestinians in West Bank village remain under Israeli settler siege for sixth day
english: For six days, Palestinian families in the village of Qusra have been trapped in their homes due to a blockade by Israeli settlers. Despite an announced military operation, the settlers remain, and reports suggest that Israeli forces have instead restricted access to the area and taken over some private homes. The families are suffering from a lack of essential supplies like food, water, and electricity as the situation continues to escalate.
amharic: በዌስት ባንክ በምትገኘው ኩስራ መንደር የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን ቤተሰቦች በእስራኤል ሰፈራ ሰፋሪዎች ከበባ ውስጥ ለስድስት ቀናት ቆይተዋል። የእስራኤል ጦር ሰፋሪዎችን ለማስወጣት ዘመቻ መጀመሩን ቢገልጽም፣ ሰፋሪዎቹ ቦታውን አልለቀቁም፤ እንዲያውም ወታደሮች አንዳንድ መኖሪያ ቤቶችን በመቆጣጠር ለነዋሪዎች የሚደርሰውን የእርዳታ አቅርቦት አግደዋል። በዚህም የተነሳ ተጎጂ ቤተሰቦች ለምግብ፣ ለውሃ እና ለኤሌክትሪክ እጥረት ተዳርገው ከፍተኛ ችግር ላይ ወድቀዋል።
oromo: Maatiiwwan Falastiinii baadiyyaa Qusraa keessa jiraatan guyyaa ja'aaf marsaa qotee bultoota Israa'elii jala jiru. Waraanni Israa'el qotee bultoota kana achii ari'uuf duula jalqabne jedhee ibsee tureyyuu, isaan achi keessaa hin baane; kanaa mannaa waraanni Israa'el manneen jireenyaa tokko tokko to'annoo jala oolchuun gargaarsi akka hin geenye dhorkaniiru. Rakkoo kana hordofuunis maatiiwwan kun nyaataa fi bishaan dhabuun rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Video: Israel inaugurates new illegal settlement in Jenin
english: Israeli Defence Minister Israel Katz officially opened a new settlement in Jenin this Thursday. This action took place immediately following the destruction of several Palestinian businesses and properties by Israeli military forces in the same area. The move highlights escalating tensions regarding territorial expansion in the region.
